verses.en: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:
verses.zh: 以色列王大卫儿子所罗门的箴言：

words.g: a pithy maxim, usually of metaphorical nature

verses.en: to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding;
verses.zh: 要使人晓得智慧和训诲，分辨通达的言语，

words.g: to + to separate mentally , i.e. understand

verses.en: to receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity;
verses.zh: 使人处事领受智慧、仁义、公平、正直的训诲，

words.g: to be  circumspect and hence, intelligent
and + evenness, i.e.  prosperity or concord

verses.en: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young man—
verses.zh: 使愚人灵明，使少年人有知识和谋略，

words.g: to + a boy , from the age of infancy to adolescence

verses.en: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel;
verses.zh: 使智慧人听见，增长学问，使聪明人得着智谋，

words.g: and + to separate mentally , i.e. understand
steerage , i.e.  guidance or  a plan

verses.en: to understand a proverb and parables, the words and riddles of the wise.
verses.zh: 使人明白箴言和譬喻，懂得智慧人的言词和谜语。

words.g: to + to separate mentally , i.e. understand
a pithy maxim, usually of metaphorical nature

verses.en: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.
verses.zh: 敬畏耶和华是知识的开端；愚妄人藐视智慧和训诲。

verses.en: My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching;
verses.zh: 我儿，要听你父亲的训诲，不可离弃你母亲的法则（或译：指教）；

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate + +you/your

verses.en: for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.
verses.zh: 因为这要作你头上的华冠，你项上的金链。

verses.en: My son, if sinners entice you, don’t consent.
verses.zh: 我儿，恶人若引诱你，你不可随从。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
to breathe after, i.e.  to be acquiescent

verses.en: If they say, “Come with us. Let’s lie in wait for blood. Let’s lurk secretly for the innocent without cause.
verses.zh: 他们若说：你与我们同去，我们要埋伏流人之血，要蹲伏害无罪之人；

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: Let’s swallow them up alive like Sheol, and whole, like those who go down into the pit.
verses.zh: 我们好像阴间，把他们活活吞下；他们如同下坑的人，被我们囫囵吞了；

verses.en: We’ll find all valuable wealth. We’ll fill our houses with plunder.
verses.zh: 我们必得各样宝物，将所掳来的，装满房屋；

verses.en: You shall cast your lot among us. We’ll all have one purse”—
verses.zh: 你与我们大家同分，我们共用一个囊袋；

verses.en: my son, don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,
verses.zh: 我儿，不要与他们同行一道，禁止你脚走他们的路。

words.g: to debar  from benefit or injury

verses.en: for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.
verses.zh: 因为，他们的脚奔跑行恶；他们急速流人的血，

words.g: and + to be liquid or flow easily, i.e

verses.en: For the net is spread in vain in the sight of any bird;
verses.zh: 好像飞鸟，网罗设在眼前仍不躲避。

verses.en: but these lay in wait for their own blood. They lurk secretly for their own lives.
verses.zh: 这些人埋伏，是为自流己血；蹲伏，是为自害己命。

verses.en: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.
verses.zh: 凡贪恋财利的，所行之路都是如此；这贪恋之心乃夺去得财者之命。

verses.en: Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares.
verses.zh: 智慧在街市上呼喊，在宽阔处发声，

words.g: in + separate by awall, i.e. outside
in + a width, i.e.  avenue or area

verses.en: She calls at the head of noisy places. At the entrance of the city gates, she utters her words:
verses.zh: 在热闹街头喊叫，在城门口，在城中发出言语，

words.g: in + an opening , i.e. door  or entrance way

verses.en: “How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools hate knowledge?
verses.zh: 说：你们愚昧人喜爱愚昧，亵慢人喜欢亵慢，愚顽人恨恶知识，要到几时呢？

words.g: and + fat, i.e.  stupid or silly

verses.en: Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.
verses.zh: 你们当因我的责备回转；我要将我的灵浇灌你们，将我的话指示你们。

verses.en: Because I have called, and you have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no one has paid attention;
verses.zh: 我呼唤，你们不肯听从；我伸手，无人理会；

words.g: to prick up the ears, i.e. hearken

verses.en: but you have ignored all my counsel, and wanted none of my reproof;
verses.zh: 反轻弃我一切的劝戒，不肯受我的责备。

words.g: to breathe after, i.e.  to be acquiescent

verses.en: I also will laugh at your disaster. I will mock when calamity overtakes you,
verses.zh: 你们遭灾难，我就发笑；惊恐临到你们，我必嗤笑。

verses.en: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when your disaster comes on like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come on you.
verses.zh: 惊恐临到你们，好像狂风；灾难来到，如同暴风；急难痛苦临到你们身上。

verses.en: Then they will call on me, but I will not answer. They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me,
verses.zh: 那时，你们必呼求我，我却不答应，恳切地寻找我，却寻不见。

words.g: to dawn, i.e.  be  early at any task + +me/my

verses.en: because they hated knowledge, and didn’t choose the fear of the LORD.
verses.zh: 因为，你们恨恶知识，不喜爱敬畏耶和华，

verses.en: They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.
verses.zh: 不听我的劝戒，藐视我一切的责备，

words.g: to breathe after, i.e.  to be acquiescent

verses.en: Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes.
verses.zh: 所以必吃自结的果子，充满自设的计谋。

verses.en: For the backsliding of the simple will kill them. The careless ease of fools will destroy them.
verses.zh: 愚昧人背道，必杀己身；愚顽人安逸，必害己命。

verses.en: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”
verses.zh: 惟有听从我的，必安然居住，得享安静，不怕灾祸。

words.g: and + to loll, i.e. be peaceful

verses.en: My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,
verses.zh: 我儿，你若领受我的言语，存记我的命令，

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
and + a command, whether human or divine + +me/my

verses.en: so as to turn your ear to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;
verses.zh: 侧耳听智慧，专心求聪明，

words.g: to + to prick up the ears, i.e. hearken

verses.en: yes, if you call out for discernment, and lift up your voice for understanding;
verses.zh: 呼求明哲，扬声求聪明，

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: if you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures;
verses.zh: 寻找它，如寻找银子，搜求它，如搜求隐藏的珍宝，

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: then you will understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.
verses.zh: 你就明白敬畏耶和华，得以认识神。

verses.en: For the LORD gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.
verses.zh: 因为，耶和华赐人智慧；知识和聪明都由他口而出。

words.g: from + the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +him/his/it

verses.en: He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity,
verses.zh: 他给正直人存留真智慧，给行为纯正的人作盾牌，

verses.en: that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints.
verses.zh: 为要保守公平人的路，护庇虔敬人的道。

words.g: to + to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one

verses.en: Then you will understand righteousness and justice, equity and every good path.
verses.zh: 你也必明白仁义、公平、正直、一切的善道。

words.g: and + evenness, i.e.  prosperity or concord

verses.en: For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.
verses.zh: 智慧必入你心；你的灵要以知识为美。

verses.en: Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,
verses.zh: 谋略必护卫你；聪明必保守你，

words.g: to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one + +you/your

verses.en: to deliver you from the way of evil, from the men who speak perverse things,
verses.zh: 要救你脱离恶道（或译：恶人的道），脱离说乖谬话的人。

verses.en: who forsake the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness,
verses.zh: 那等人舍弃正直的路，行走黑暗的道，

verses.en: who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the perverseness of evil,
verses.zh: 欢喜作恶，喜爱恶人的乖僻，

words.g: to spin round , i.e. usually rejoice

verses.en: who are crooked in their ways, and wayward in their paths,
verses.zh: 在他们的道中弯曲，在他们的路上偏僻。

words.g: and + to turn aside , i.e.  to depart

verses.en: to deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words,
verses.zh: 智慧要救你脱离淫妇，就是那油嘴滑舌的外女。

words.g: from + strange, in a variety of degrees and applications

verses.en: who forsakes the friend of her youth, and forgets the covenant of her God;
verses.zh: 她离弃幼年的配偶，忘了神的盟约。

words.g: youth, the state  or the persons + +her/its
to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of

verses.en: for her house leads down to death, her paths to the departed spirits.
verses.zh: 她的家陷入死地；她的路偏向阴间。

verses.en: None who go to her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life.
verses.zh: 凡到她那里去的，不得转回，也得不着生命的路。

verses.en: Therefore walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.
verses.zh: 智慧必使你行善人的道，守义人的路。

verses.en: For the upright will dwell in the land. The perfect will remain in it.
verses.zh: 正直人必在世上居住；完全人必在地上存留。

verses.en: But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.
verses.zh: 惟有恶人必然剪除；奸诈的，必然拔出。

verses.en: My son, don’t forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments,
verses.zh: 我儿，不要忘记我的法则（或译：指教）；你心要谨守我的诫命；

words.g: to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of
and + a command, whether human or divine + +me/my
to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one

verses.en: for they will add to you length of days, years of life, and peace.
verses.zh: 因为它必将长久的日子，生命的年数与平安，加给你。

verses.en: Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
verses.zh: 不可使慈爱、诚实离开你，要系在你颈项上，刻在你心版上。

verses.en: So you will find favor, and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
verses.zh: 这样，你必在神和世人眼前蒙恩宠，有聪明。

verses.en: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.
verses.zh: 你要专心仰赖耶和华，不可倚靠自己的聪明，

verses.en: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
verses.zh: 在你一切所行的事上都要认定他，他必指引你的路。

verses.en: Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear the LORD, and depart from evil.
verses.zh: 不要自以为有智慧；要敬畏耶和华，远离恶事。

verses.en: It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.
verses.zh: 这便医治你的肚脐，滋润你的百骨。

words.g: to + a string , i.e.  the umbilical cord + +you/your

verses.en: Honor the LORD with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase;
verses.zh: 你要以财物和一切初熟的土产尊荣耶和华。

verses.en: so your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.
verses.zh: 这样，你的仓房必充满有余；你的酒榨有新酒盈溢。

verses.en: My son, don’t despise the LORD’s discipline, neither be weary of his correction;
verses.zh: 我儿，你不可轻看耶和华的管教（或译：惩治），也不可厌烦他的责备；

verses.en: for whom the LORD loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.
verses.zh: 因为耶和华所爱的，他必责备，正如父亲责备所喜爱的儿子。

words.g: and + like + father, in a literal and immediate

verses.en: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.
verses.zh: 得智慧，得聪明的，这人便为有福。

verses.en: For her good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold.
verses.zh: 因为得智慧胜过得银子，其利益强如精金，

verses.en: She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her.
verses.zh: 比珍珠（或译：红宝石）宝贵；你一切所喜爱的，都不足与比较。

verses.en: Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor.
verses.zh: 她右手有长寿，左手有富贵。

words.g: and + weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace.
verses.zh: 她的道是安乐；她的路全是平安。

verses.en: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.
verses.zh: 她与持守她的作生命树；持定她的，俱各有福。

verses.en: By wisdom the LORD founded the earth. By understanding, he established the heavens.
verses.zh: 耶和华以智慧立地，以聪明定天，

verses.en: By his knowledge, the depths were broken up, and the skies drop down the dew.
verses.zh: 以知识使深渊裂开，使天空滴下甘露。

verses.en: My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion,
verses.zh: 我儿，要谨守真智慧和谋略，不可使她离开你的眼目。

words.g: to turn aside , i.e.  to depart
to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one

verses.en: so they will be life to your soul, and grace for your neck.
verses.zh: 这样，她必作你的生命，颈项的美饰。

words.g: and + graciousness, i.e. subjective  or objective

verses.en: Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.
verses.zh: 你就坦然行路，不致碰脚。

verses.en: When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.
verses.zh: 你躺下，必不惧怕；你躺卧，睡得香甜。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes;
verses.zh: 忽然来的惊恐，不要害怕；恶人遭毁灭，也不要恐惧。

verses.en: for the LORD will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.
verses.zh: 因为耶和华是你所倚靠的；他必保守你的脚不陷入网罗。

words.g: in + fatness, i.e. by implication  the loin  or  the viscera + +you/your
from + something to capture with, i.e. a noose

verses.en: Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.
verses.zh: 你手若有行善的力量，不可推辞，就当向那应得的人施行。

words.g: to debar  from benefit or injury

verses.en: Don’t say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you,” when you have it by you.
verses.zh: 你那里若有现成的，不可对邻舍说：去吧，明天再来，我必给你。

verses.en: Don’t devise evil against your neighbor, since he dwells securely by you.
verses.zh: 你的邻舍既在你附近安居，你不可设计害他。

verses.en: Don’t strive with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm.
verses.zh: 人未曾加害与你，不可无故与他相争。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
to treat a person , i.e. benefit or requite + +you/your

verses.en: Don’t envy the man of violence. Choose none of his ways.
verses.zh: 不可嫉妒强暴的人，也不可选择他所行的路。

words.g: to be  zealous, i.e.  jealous or envious

verses.en: For the perverse is an abomination to the LORD, but his friendship is with the upright.
verses.zh: 因为，乖僻人为耶和华所憎恶；正直人为他所亲密。

words.g: to turn aside , i.e.  to depart

verses.en: The LORD’s curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.
verses.zh: 耶和华咒诅恶人的家庭，赐福与义人的居所。

verses.en: Surely he mocks the mockers, but he gives grace to the humble.
verses.zh: 他讥诮那好讥诮的人，赐恩给谦卑的人。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
and + to + depressed , in mind  or circumstances

verses.en: The wise will inherit glory, but shame will be the promotion of fools.
verses.zh: 智慧人必承受尊荣；愚昧人高升也成为羞辱。

words.g: weight, but only figuratively in a good sense
to inherit  mode of descent), or  to occupy
and + fat, i.e.  stupid or silly
to be high actively, to rise or raise

verses.en: Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;
verses.zh: 众子啊，要听父亲的教训，留心得知聪明。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate
and + to prick up the ears, i.e. hearken

verses.en: for I give you sound learning. Don’t forsake my law.
verses.zh: 因我所给你们的是好教训；不可离弃我的法则（或译：指教）。

verses.en: For I was a son to my father, tender and an only child in the sight of my mother.
verses.zh: 我在父亲面前为孝子，在母亲眼中为独一的娇儿。

words.g: to + father, in a literal and immediate + +me/my

verses.en: He taught me, and said to me: “Let your heart retain my words. Keep my commandments, and live.
verses.zh: 父亲教训我说：你心要存记我的言语，遵守我的命令，便得存活。

words.g: a command, whether human or divine + +me/my
and + to live, whether literally or figuratively

verses.en: Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget, and don’t deviate from the words of my mouth.
verses.zh: 要得智慧，要得聪明，不可忘记，也不可偏离我口中的言语。

words.g: to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of
the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +me/my

verses.en: Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you. Love her, and she will keep you.
verses.zh: 不可离弃智慧，智慧就护卫你；要爱她，她就保守你。

words.g: and + to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one + +you/your

verses.en: Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.
verses.zh: 智慧为首；所以，要得智慧。在你一切所得之内必得聪明（或译：用你一切所得的去换聪明）。

verses.en: Esteem her, and she will exalt you. She will bring you to honor when you embrace her.
verses.zh: 高举智慧，她就使你高升；怀抱智慧，她就使你尊荣。

words.g: and + to be high actively, to rise or raise + +you/your

verses.en: She will give to your head a garland of grace. She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.”
verses.zh: 她必将华冠加在你头上，把荣冕交给你。

verses.en: Listen, my son, and receive my sayings. The years of your life will be many.
verses.zh: 我儿，你要听受我的言语，就必延年益寿。

verses.en: I have taught you in the way of wisdom. I have led you in straight paths.
verses.zh: 我已指教你走智慧的道，引导你行正直的路。

verses.en: When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.
verses.zh: 你行走，脚步必不致狭窄；你奔跑，也不致跌倒。

words.g: and + used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: Take firm hold of instruction. Don’t let her go. Keep her, for she is your life.
verses.zh: 要持定训诲，不可放松；必当谨守，因为它是你的生命。

words.g: to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one + +her/its

verses.en: Don’t enter into the path of the wicked. Don’t walk in the way of evil men.
verses.zh: 不可行恶人的路；不要走坏人的道。

verses.en: Avoid it, and don’t pass by it. Turn from it, and pass on.
verses.zh: 要躲避，不可经过；要转身而去。

verses.en: For they don’t sleep unless they do evil. Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall.
verses.zh: 这等人若不行恶，不得睡觉；不使人跌倒，睡卧不安；

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.
verses.zh: 因为他们以奸恶吃饼，以强暴喝酒。

verses.en: But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.
verses.zh: 但义人的路好像黎明的光，越照越明，直到日午。

verses.zh: 恶人的道好像幽暗，自己不知因甚么跌倒。

verses.zh: 都不可离你的眼目，要存记在你心中。

verses.en: For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.
verses.zh: 因为得着它的，就得了生命，又得了医全体的良药。

verses.en: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.
verses.zh: 你要保守你心，胜过保守一切（或译：你要切切保守你心），因为一生的果效是由心发出。

words.g: to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one

verses.en: Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you.
verses.zh: 你要除掉邪僻的口，弃绝乖谬的嘴。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative
to widen , i.e.  recede or  remove

verses.zh: 你的眼目要向前正看；你的眼睛（原文是皮）当向前直观。

verses.en: Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.
verses.zh: 要修平你脚下的路，坚定你一切的道。

verses.en: Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.
verses.zh: 不可偏向左右；要使你的脚离开邪恶。

verses.en: My son, pay attention to my wisdom. Turn your ear to my understanding,
verses.zh: 我儿，要留心我智慧的话语，侧耳听我聪明的言词，

words.g: to prick up the ears, i.e. hearken

verses.en: that you may maintain discretion, that your lips may preserve knowledge.
verses.zh: 为要使你谨守谋略，嘴唇保存知识。

words.g: to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one

verses.en: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil,
verses.zh: 因为淫妇的嘴滴下蜂蜜；她的口比油更滑，

words.g: the palate or inside of the mouth + +her/its

verses.en: but in the end she is as bitter as wormwood, and as sharp as a two-edged sword.
verses.zh: 至终却苦似茵蔯，快如两刃的刀。

words.g: and + the last or end, hence + +her/its
the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.zh: 她的脚下入死地；她脚步踏住阴间，

verses.en: She gives no thought to the way of life. Her ways are crooked, and she doesn’t know it.
verses.zh: 以致她找不着生命平坦的道。她的路变迁不定，自己还不知道。

verses.zh: 众子啊，现在要听从我；不可离弃我口中的话。

verses.zh: 你所行的道要离她远，不可就近她的房门，

an opening , i.e. door  or entrance way

verses.zh: 恐怕将你的尊荣给别人，将你的岁月给残忍的人；

verses.en: lest strangers feast on your wealth, and your labors enrich another man’s house.
verses.zh: 恐怕外人满得你的力量，你劳碌得来的，归入外人的家；

words.g: strange, in a variety of degrees and applications

verses.zh: 终久，你皮肉和身体消毁，你就悲叹，

verses.zh: 说：我怎么恨恶训诲，心中藐视责备，

verses.zh: 也不听从我师傅的话，又不侧耳听那教训我的人？

words.g: and + to + to goad, i.e.  to teach + +me/my

verses.zh: 我在圣会里，几乎落在诸般恶中。

verses.zh: 你要喝自己池中的水，饮自己井里的活水。

words.g: and + to drip, or shed by trickling

verses.zh: 你的泉源岂可涨溢在外？你的河水岂可流在街上？

in + a width, i.e.  avenue or area

verses.en: Let them be for yourself alone, not for strangers with you.
verses.zh: 惟独归你一人，不可与外人同用。

verses.zh: 要使你的泉源蒙福；要喜悦你幼年所娶的妻。

words.g: youth, the state  or the persons + +you/your

verses.en: A loving doe and a graceful deer— let her breasts satisfy you at all times. Be captivated always with her love.
verses.zh: 她如可爱的麀鹿，可喜的母鹿；愿她的胸怀使你时时知足，她的爱情使你常常恋慕。

verses.en: For why should you, my son, be captivated with an adulteress? Why embrace the bosom of another?
verses.zh: 我儿，你为何恋慕淫妇？为何抱外女的胸怀？

verses.zh: 因为，人所行的道都在耶和华眼前；他也修平人一切的路。

verses.en: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.
verses.zh: 恶人必被自己的罪孽捉住；他必被自己的罪恶如绳索缠绕。

verses.zh: 他因不受训诲就必死亡；又因愚昧过甚，必走差了路。

verses.zh: 我儿，你若为朋友作保，替外人击掌，

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.zh: 你就被口中的话语缠住，被嘴里的言语捉住。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +you/your
the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +you/your

verses.zh: 我儿，你既落在朋友手中，就当这样行才可救自己：你要自卑，去恳求你的朋友。

words.g: and + to urge severely, i.e.  importune

verses.en: Give no sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids.
verses.zh: 不要容你的眼睛睡觉；不要容你的眼皮打盹。

verses.zh: 要救自己，如鹿脱离猎户的手，如鸟脱离捕鸟人的手。

verses.zh: 懒惰人哪，你去察看蚂蚁的动作就可得智慧。

verses.en: which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,
verses.zh: 蚂蚁没有元帅，没有官长，没有君王，

words.g: a scribe, i.e.  an official superintendent or magistrate

verses.zh: 尚且在夏天预备食物，在收割时聚敛粮食。

words.g: in + harvest , whether the product  or the  season

verses.zh: 懒惰人哪，你要睡到几时呢？你何时睡醒呢？

verses.en: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep—
verses.zh: 再睡片时，打盹片时，抱着手躺卧片时，

verses.en: so your poverty will come as a robber, and your scarcity as an armed man.
verses.zh: 你的贫穷就必如强盗速来，你的缺乏彷佛拿兵器的人来到。

verses.en: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth,
verses.zh: 无赖的恶徒，行动就用乖僻的口，

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.zh: 用眼传神，用脚示意，用指点划，

in + something to sieze with, i.e. a finger + +him/his/it

verses.en: in whose heart is perverseness, who devises evil continually, who always sows discord.
verses.zh: 心中乖僻，常设恶谋，布散纷争。

verses.en: Therefore his calamity will come suddenly. He will be broken suddenly, and that without remedy.
verses.zh: 所以，灾难必忽然临到他身；他必顷刻败坏，无法可治。

verses.en: There are six things which the LORD hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:
verses.zh: 耶和华所恨恶的有六样，连他心所憎恶的共有七样：

verses.zh: 就是高傲的眼，撒谎的舌，流无辜人血的手，

words.g: to be high actively, to rise or raise

verses.en: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are swift in running to mischief,
verses.zh: 图谋恶计的心，飞跑行恶的脚，

words.g: to be liquid or flow easily, i.e

verses.zh: 吐谎言的假见证，并弟兄中布散纷争的人。

words.g: to puff, i.e. blow with the breath or air

father, in a literal and immediate + +you/your

verses.zh: 要常系在你心上，挂在你项上。

verses.zh: 你行走，它必引导你；你躺卧，它必保守你；你睡醒，它必与你谈论。

verses.zh: 能保你远离恶妇，远离外女谄媚的舌头。

verses.zh: 你心中不要恋慕她的美色，也不要被她眼皮勾引。

verses.zh: 因为，妓女能使人只剩一块饼；淫妇猎取人宝贵的生命。

words.g: a circle, i.e.  a circumjacent tract or region

verses.zh: 人若怀里搋火，衣服岂能不烧呢？

verses.en: Or can one walk on hot coals, and his feet not be scorched?
verses.zh: 人若在火炭上走，脚岂能不烫呢？

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.zh: 亲近邻舍之妻的，也是如此；凡挨近她的，不免受罚。

verses.zh: 贼因饥饿偷窃充饥，人不藐视他，

verses.zh: 若被找着，他必赔还七倍，必将家中所有的尽都偿还。

verses.zh: 与妇人行淫的，便是无知；行这事的，必丧掉生命。

verses.en: He will get wounds and dishonor. His reproach will not be wiped away.
verses.zh: 他必受伤损，必被凌辱；他的羞耻不得涂抹。

verses.en: For jealousy arouses the fury of the husband. He won’t spare in the day of vengeance.
verses.zh: 因为人的嫉恨成了烈怒，报仇的时候决不留情。

verses.en: He won’t regard any ransom, neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts.
verses.zh: 甚么赎价，他都不顾；你虽送许多礼物，他也不肯干休。

words.g: to breathe after, i.e.  to be acquiescent

verses.zh: 我儿，你要遵守我的言语，将我的命令存记在心。

verses.zh: 遵守我的命令就得存活；保守我的法则（或译：指教），好像保守眼中的瞳人，

and + to live, whether literally or figuratively
like + the little man of the eye

verses.zh: 系在你指头上，刻在你心版上。

words.g: something to sieze with, i.e. a finger + +you/your

verses.zh: 对智慧说：你是我的姊妹，称呼聪明为你的亲人，

verses.zh: 她就保你远离淫妇，远离说谄媚话的外女。

verses.zh: 我曾在我房屋的窗户内，从我窗棂之间往外观看：

words.g: to lean out , i.e.  peep or gaze

verses.zh: 见愚蒙人内，少年人中，分明有一个无知的少年人，

words.g: a boy , from the age of infancy to adolescence

verses.zh: 从街上经过，走近淫妇的巷口，直往通她家的路去，

verses.zh: 有时在街市上，有时在宽阔处，或在各巷口蹲伏，

words.g: in + separate by awall, i.e. outside

verses.zh: 拉住那少年人，与他亲嘴，脸无羞耻对他说：

words.g: and + to kiss, literally or figuratively

verses.zh: 平安祭在我这里，今日才还了我所许的愿。

words.g: requital, i.e. a  sacrifice in thanks

verses.zh: 因此，我出来迎接你，恳切求见你的面，恰巧遇见了你。

words.g: to + to dawn, i.e.  be  early at any task

verses.zh: 我已经用绣花毯子和埃及线织的花纹布铺了我的床。

words.g: Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt

verses.en: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
verses.zh: 我又用没药、沉香、桂皮薰了我的榻。

verses.en: Come, let’s take our fill of loving until the morning. Let’s solace ourselves with loving.
verses.zh: 你来，我们可以饱享爱情，直到早晨；我们可以彼此亲爱欢乐。

words.g: to leap for joy, i.e. exult

verses.en: For my husband isn’t at home. He has gone on a long journey.
verses.zh: 因为我丈夫不在家，出门行远路；

verses.zh: 他手拿银囊，必到月望才回家。

words.g: the + fulness or the full moon, i.e. its festival

verses.zh: 淫妇用许多巧言诱他随从，用谄媚的嘴逼他同行。

verses.zh: 少年人立刻跟随她，好像牛往宰杀之地；又像愚昧人带锁链去受刑罚，

verses.en: Until an arrow strikes through his liver, as a bird hurries to the snare, and doesn’t know that it will cost his life.
verses.zh: 直等箭穿他的肝；如同雀鸟急入网罗，却不知是自丧己命。

verses.zh: 因为，被她伤害仆倒的不少；被她杀戮的而且甚多。

verses.zh: 她的家是在阴间之路，下到死亡之宫。

verses.zh: 智慧岂不呼叫？聪明岂不发声？

verses.en: On the top of high places by the way, where the paths meet, she stands.
verses.zh: 她在道旁高处的顶上，在十字路口站立，

verses.zh: 在城门旁，在城门口，在城门洞，大声说：

verses.zh: 众人哪，我呼叫你们，我向世人发声。

verses.zh: 说：愚蒙人哪，你们要会悟灵明；愚昧人哪，你们当心里明白。

verses.zh: 你们当听，因我要说极美的话；我张嘴要论正直的事。

verses.en: For my mouth speaks truth. Wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
verses.zh: 我的口要发出真理；我的嘴憎恶邪恶。

verses.en: Receive my instruction rather than silver, knowledge rather than choice gold.
verses.zh: 你们当受我的教训，不受白银；宁得知识，胜过黄金。

verses.en: For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can’t be compared to it.
verses.zh: 因为智慧比珍珠（或译：红宝石）更美；一切可喜爱的都不足与比较。

verses.en: “I, wisdom, have made prudence my dwelling. Find out knowledge and discretion.
verses.zh: 我―智慧以灵明为居所，又寻得知识和谋略。

verses.en: The fear of the LORD is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.
verses.zh: 敬畏耶和华在乎恨恶邪恶；那骄傲、狂妄，并恶道，以及乖谬的口，都为我所恨恶。

words.g: and + the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.en: Counsel and sound knowledge are mine. I have understanding and power.
verses.zh: 我有谋略和真知识；我乃聪明，我有能力。

words.g: and + support or  ability, i.e.  help

verses.en: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.
verses.zh: 帝王藉我坐国位；君王藉我定公平。

words.g: and + probably to be heavy, i.e.  honorable

verses.en: By me princes rule, nobles, and all the righteous rulers of the earth.
verses.zh: 王子和首领，世上一切的审判官，都是藉我掌权。

verses.en: I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.
verses.zh: 爱我的，我也爱他；恳切寻求我的，必寻得见。

words.g: and + to dawn, i.e.  be  early at any task + +me/my

verses.en: With me are riches, honor, enduring wealth, and prosperity.
verses.zh: 丰富尊荣在我；恒久的财并公义也在我。

words.g: and + weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold, my yield than choice silver.
verses.zh: 我的果实胜过黄金，强如精金；我的出产超乎高银。

verses.en: I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice,
verses.zh: 我在公义的道上走，在公平的路中行，

verses.en: that I may give wealth to those who love me. I fill their treasuries.
verses.zh: 使爱我的，承受货财，并充满他们的府库。

words.g: to + to inherit  mode of descent), or  to occupy

verses.en: “The LORD possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old.
verses.zh: 在耶和华造化的起头，在太初创造万物之先，就有了我。

verses.en: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, before the earth existed.
verses.zh: 从亘古，从太初，未有世界以前，我已被立。

words.g: to pour out, especially a libation

verses.en: When there were no depths, I was born, when there were no springs abounding with water.
verses.zh: 没有深渊，没有大水的泉源，我已生出。

words.g: to twist or whirl , i.e.  to dance

verses.en: Before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was born;
verses.zh: 大山未曾奠定，小山未有之先，我已生出。

words.g: to twist or whirl , i.e.  to dance

verses.en: while as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the beginning of the dust of the world.
verses.zh: 耶和华还没有创造大地和田野，并世上的土质，我已生出。

words.g: and + separate by awall, i.e. outside

verses.en: When he established the heavens, I was there. When he set a circle on the surface of the deep,
verses.zh: 他立高天，我在那里；他在渊面的周围，划出圆圈。

verses.en: when he established the clouds above, when the springs of the deep became strong,
verses.zh: 上使穹苍坚硬，下使渊源稳固，

words.g: in + to be alert, physically  or mentally + +him/his/it
from + the upper part, used only adverbially with prefix upward

verses.en: when he gave to the sea its boundary, that the waters should not violate his commandment, when he marked out the foundations of the earth,
verses.zh: 为沧海定出界限，使水不越过他的命令，立定大地的根基。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +him/his/it

verses.en: then I was the craftsman by his side. I was a delight day by day, always rejoicing before him,
verses.zh: 那时，我在他那里为工师，日日为他所喜爱，常常在他面前踊跃，

verses.en: rejoicing in his whole world. My delight was with the sons of men.
verses.zh: 踊跃在他为人预备可住之地，也喜悦住在世人之间。

verses.en: “Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.
verses.zh: 众子啊，现在要听从我，因为谨守我道的，便为有福。

verses.en: Hear instruction, and be wise. Don’t refuse it.
verses.zh: 要听教训就得智慧，不可弃绝。

verses.en: Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.
verses.zh: 听从我、日日在我门口仰望、在我门框旁边等候的，那人便为有福。

words.g: to + to be alert, i.e. sleepless
something swinging, i.e. the valve of adoor + +me/my
an opening , i.e. door  or entrance way + +me/my

verses.en: For whoever finds me finds life, and will obtain favor from the LORD.
verses.zh: 因为寻得我的，就寻得生命，也必蒙耶和华的恩惠。

verses.en: But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”
verses.zh: 得罪我的，却害了自己的性命；恨恶我的，都喜爱死亡。

verses.en: Wisdom has built her house. She has carved out her seven pillars.
verses.zh: 智慧建造房屋，凿成七根柱子，

verses.en: She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table.
verses.zh: 宰杀牲畜，调和旨酒，设摆筵席；

words.g: to set in a row, i.e. arrange

verses.en: She has sent out her maidens. She cries from the highest places of the city:
verses.zh: 打发使女出去，自己在城中至高处呼叫，

verses.en: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,
verses.zh: 说：谁是愚蒙人，可以转到这里来！又对那无知的人说：

verses.en: “Come, eat some of my bread, Drink some of the wine which I have mixed!
verses.zh: 你们来，吃我的饼，喝我调和的酒。

verses.en: Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”
verses.zh: 你们愚蒙人，要舍弃愚蒙，就得存活，并要走光明的道。

words.g: and + to live, whether literally or figuratively

verses.en: One who corrects a mocker invites insult. One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.
verses.zh: 指斥亵慢人的，必受辱骂；责备恶人的，必被玷污。

verses.en: Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.
verses.zh: 不要责备亵慢人，恐怕他恨你；要责备智慧人，他必爱你。

verses.en: Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.
verses.zh: 教导智慧人，他就越发有智慧；指示义人，他就增长学问。

verses.en: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
verses.zh: 敬畏耶和华是智慧的开端；认识至圣者便是聪明。

verses.en: For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased.
verses.zh: 你藉着我，日子必增多，年岁也必加添。

verses.en: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it.
verses.zh: 你若有智慧，是与自己有益；你若亵慢，就必独自担当。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: The foolish woman is loud, undisciplined, and knows nothing.
verses.zh: 愚昧的妇人喧嚷；她是愚蒙，一无所知。

verses.en: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,
verses.zh: 她坐在自己的家门口，坐在城中高处的座位上，

words.g: to + an opening , i.e. door  or entrance way

verses.en: to call to those who pass by, who go straight on their ways,
verses.zh: 呼叫过路的，就是直行其道的人，

words.g: the + to be straight or even

verses.en: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here.” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,
verses.zh: 说：谁是愚蒙人，可以转到这里来！又对那无知的人说：

verses.en: “Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant.”
verses.zh: 偷来的水是甜的，暗吃的饼是好的。

verses.en: But he doesn’t know that the departed spirits are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
verses.zh: 人却不知有阴魂在她那里；她的客在阴间的深处。

verses.en: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.
verses.zh: 所罗门的箴言：智慧之子使父亲欢乐；愚昧之子叫母亲担忧。

words.g: a pithy maxim, usually of metaphorical nature
father, in a literal and immediate

verses.en: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death.
verses.zh: 不义之财毫无益处；惟有公义能救人脱离死亡。

verses.en: The LORD will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.
verses.zh: 耶和华不使义人受饥饿；恶人所欲的，他必推开。

verses.en: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.
verses.zh: 手懒的，要受贫穷；手勤的，却要富足。

verses.en: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.
verses.zh: 夏天聚敛的，是智慧之子；收割时沉睡的，是贻羞之子。

words.g: in + harvest , whether the product  or the  season
to be  circumspect and hence, intelligent
to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed

verses.en: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
verses.zh: 福祉临到义人的头；强暴蒙蔽恶人的口。

words.g: and + the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.en: The memory of the righteous is blessed, but the name of the wicked will rot.
verses.zh: 义人的纪念被称赞；恶人的名字必朽烂。

verses.en: The wise in heart accept commandments, but a chattering fool will fall.
verses.zh: 心中智慧的，必受命令；口里愚妄的，必致倾倒。

words.g: a command, whether human or divine

verses.en: He who walks blamelessly walks surely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.
verses.zh: 行正直路的，步步安稳；走弯曲道的，必致败露。

verses.en: One who winks with the eye causes sorrow, but a chattering fool will fall.
verses.zh: 以眼传神的，使人忧患；口里愚妄的，必致倾倒。

words.g: to pinch, i.e.  to bite the lips

verses.en: The mouth of the righteous is a spring of life, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
verses.zh: 义人的口是生命的泉源；强暴蒙蔽恶人的口。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative
and + the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.en: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.
verses.zh: 恨能挑启争端；爱能遮掩一切过错。

verses.en: Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment, but a rod is for the back of him who is void of understanding.
verses.zh: 明哲人嘴里有智慧；无知人背上受刑杖。

verses.en: Wise men lay up knowledge, but the mouth of the foolish is near ruin.
verses.zh: 智慧人积存知识；愚妄人的口速致败坏。

words.g: and + the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.en: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty.
verses.zh: 富户的财物是他的坚城；穷人的贫乏是他的败坏。

verses.en: The labor of the righteous leads to life. The increase of the wicked leads to sin.
verses.zh: 义人的勤劳致生；恶人的进项致死（死：原文是罪）。

words.g: to + an offence , and its penalty

verses.en: He is in the way of life who heeds correction, but he who forsakes reproof leads others astray.
verses.zh: 谨守训诲的，乃在生命的道上；违弃责备的，便失迷了路。

words.g: to vacillate, i.e. reel or stray

verses.en: He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool.
verses.zh: 隐藏怨恨的，有说谎的嘴；口出谗谤的，是愚妄的人。

verses.en: In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely.
verses.zh: 多言多语难免有过；禁止嘴唇是有智慧。

words.g: to be  circumspect and hence, intelligent

verses.en: The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.
verses.zh: 义人的舌乃似高银；恶人的心所值无几。

verses.en: The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.
verses.zh: 义人的口教养多人；愚昧人因无知而死亡。

verses.en: The LORD’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.
verses.zh: 耶和华所赐的福使人富足，并不加上忧虑。

verses.en: It is a fool’s pleasure to do wickedness, but wisdom is a man of understanding’s pleasure.
verses.zh: 愚妄人以行恶为戏耍；明哲人却以智慧为乐。

words.g: to + fat, i.e.  stupid or silly
a plan, especially a bad one

verses.en: What the wicked fear will overtake them, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.
verses.zh: 恶人所怕的，必临到他；义人所愿的，必蒙应允。

verses.en: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more; but the righteous stand firm forever.
verses.zh: 暴风一过，恶人归于无有；义人的根基却是永久。

verses.en: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to those who send him.
verses.zh: 懒惰人叫差他的人如醋倒牙，如烟薰目。

words.g: and + like + smoke, literally or figuratively

verses.en: The fear of the LORD prolongs days, but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
verses.zh: 敬畏耶和华使人日子加多；但恶人的年岁必被减少。

verses.en: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hope of the wicked will perish.
verses.zh: 义人的盼望必得喜乐；恶人的指望必致灭没。

verses.en: The way of the LORD is a stronghold to the upright, but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
verses.zh: 耶和华的道是正直人的保障，却成了作孽人的败坏。

words.g: to + to do or make , especially to practise

verses.en: The righteous will never be removed, but the wicked will not dwell in the land.
verses.zh: 义人永不挪移；恶人不得住在地上。

verses.en: The mouth of the righteous produces wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off.
verses.zh: 义人的口滋生智慧；乖谬的舌必被割断。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.en: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.
verses.zh: 义人的嘴能令人喜悦；恶人的口说乖谬的话。

words.g: and + the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.en: A false balance is an abomination to the LORD, but accurate weights are his delight.
verses.zh: 诡诈的天平为耶和华所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

verses.en: When pride comes, then comes shame, but with humility comes wisdom.
verses.zh: 骄傲来，羞耻也来；谦逊人却有智慧。

verses.en: The integrity of the upright shall guide them, but the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.
verses.zh: 正直人的纯正必引导自己；奸诈人的乖僻必毁灭自己。

verses.en: Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.
verses.zh: 发怒的日子资财无益；惟有公义能救人脱离死亡。

verses.en: The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way, but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
verses.zh: 完全人的义必指引他的路；但恶人必因自己的恶跌倒。

verses.en: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them, but the unfaithful will be trapped by evil desires.
verses.zh: 正直人的义必拯救自己；奸诈人必陷在自己的罪孽中。

verses.en: When a wicked man dies, hope perishes, and expectation of power comes to nothing.
verses.zh: 恶人一死，他的指望必灭绝；罪人的盼望也必灭没。

verses.en: A righteous person is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked takes his place.
verses.zh: 义人得脱离患难，有恶人来代替他。

verses.en: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.
verses.zh: 不虔敬的人用口败坏邻舍；义人却因知识得救。

words.g: in + the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.en: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.
verses.zh: 义人享福，合城喜乐；恶人灭亡，人都欢呼。

words.g: in + good , in the widest sense
to jump for joy, i.e. exult

verses.en: By the blessing of the upright, the city is exalted, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
verses.zh: 城因正直人祝福便高举，却因邪恶人的口就倾覆。

words.g: to be high actively, to rise or raise
and + in + the mouth , whether literal or figurative
to pull down or in pieces, break

verses.en: One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding holds his peace.
verses.zh: 藐视邻舍的，毫无智慧；明哲人却静默不言。

verses.en: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.
verses.zh: 往来传舌的，泄漏密事；心中诚实的，遮隐事情。

verses.en: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.
verses.zh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

words.g: steerage , i.e.  guidance or  a plan

verses.en: He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it, but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure.
verses.zh: 为外人作保的，必受亏损；恨恶击掌的，却得安稳。

verses.en: A gracious woman obtains honor, but violent men obtain riches.
verses.zh: 恩德的妇女得尊荣；强暴的男子得资财。

words.g: weight, but only figuratively in a good sense
and + fearful, i.e. powerful or tyrannical

verses.en: The merciful man does good to his own soul, but he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.
verses.zh: 仁慈的人善待自己；残忍的人扰害己身。

words.g: to treat a person , i.e. benefit or requite

verses.en: Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.
verses.zh: 恶人经营，得虚浮的工价；撒义种的，得实在的果效。

verses.en: He who is truly righteous gets life. He who pursues evil gets death.
verses.zh: 恒心为义的，必得生命；追求邪恶的，必致死亡。

verses.en: Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to the LORD, but those whose ways are blameless are his delight.
verses.zh: 心中乖僻的，为耶和华所憎恶；行事完全的，为他所喜悦。

verses.en: Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.
verses.zh: 恶人虽然连手，必不免受罚；义人的后裔必得拯救。

words.g: to be smooth, i.e.  to escape

verses.en: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout, is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.
verses.zh: 妇女美貌而无见识，如同金环带在猪鼻上。

verses.en: The desire of the righteous is only good. The expectation of the wicked is wrath.
verses.zh: 义人的心愿尽得好处；恶人的指望致干忿怒。

verses.en: There is one who scatters, and increases yet more. There is one who withholds more than is appropriate, but gains poverty.
verses.zh: 有施散的，却更增添；有吝惜过度的，反致穷乏。

words.g: to scatter, whether in enmity or bounty

verses.en: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.
verses.zh: 好施舍的，必得丰裕；滋润人的，必得滋润。

verses.en: People curse someone who withholds grain, but blessing will be on the head of him who sells it.
verses.zh: 屯粮不卖的，民必咒诅他；情愿出卖的，人必为他祝福。

words.g: to debar  from benefit or injury

verses.en: He who diligently seeks good seeks favor, but he who searches after evil, it shall come to him.
verses.zh: 恳切求善的，就求得恩惠；惟独求恶的，恶必临到他身。

words.g: to dawn, i.e.  be  early at any task

verses.en: He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.
verses.zh: 倚仗自己财物的，必跌倒；义人必发旺，如青叶。

words.g: to break forth as a bud, i.e. bloom

verses.en: He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind. The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.
verses.zh: 扰害己家的，必承受清风；愚昧人必作慧心人的仆人。

words.g: to inherit  mode of descent), or  to occupy

verses.en: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life. He who is wise wins souls.
verses.zh: 义人所结的果子就是生命树；有智慧的，必能得人。

verses.en: Behold, the righteous shall be repaid on the earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner!
verses.zh: 看哪，义人在世尚且受报，何况恶人和罪人呢？

verses.en: Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.
verses.zh: 喜爱管教的，就是喜爱知识；恨恶责备的，却是畜类。

verses.en: A good man shall obtain favor from the LORD, but he will condemn a man of wicked plans.
verses.zh: 善人必蒙耶和华的恩惠；设诡计的人，耶和华必定他的罪。

verses.en: A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
verses.zh: 人靠恶行不能坚立；义人的根必不动摇。

verses.en: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband, but a disgraceful wife is as rottenness in his bones.
verses.zh: 才德的妇人是丈夫的冠冕；贻羞的妇人如同朽烂在她丈夫的骨中。

words.g: probably a force, whether of men
to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed

verses.en: The thoughts of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.
verses.zh: 义人的思念是公平；恶人的计谋是诡诈。

words.g: steerage , i.e.  guidance or  a plan

verses.en: The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.
verses.zh: 恶人的言论是埋伏流人的血；正直人的口必拯救人。

words.g: and + the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.en: The wicked are overthrown, and are no more, but the house of the righteous shall stand.
verses.zh: 恶人倾覆，归于无有；义人的家必站得住。

verses.en: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom, but he who has a warped mind shall be despised.
verses.zh: 人必按自己的智慧被称赞；心中乖谬的，必被藐视。

words.g: to + the mouth , whether literal or figurative
and + to crook, literally or figuratively

verses.en: Better is he who is little known, and has a servant, than he who honors himself and lacks bread.
verses.zh: 被人轻贱，却有仆人，强如自尊，缺少食物。

verses.en: A righteous man respects the life of his animal, but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
verses.zh: 义人顾惜他牲畜的命；恶人的怜悯也是残忍。

verses.en: He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.
verses.zh: 耕种自己田地的，必得饱食；追随虚浮的，却是无知。

verses.en: The wicked desires the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.
verses.zh: 恶人想得坏人的网罗；义人的根得以结实。

verses.en: An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips, but the righteous shall come out of trouble.
verses.zh: 恶人嘴中的过错是自己的网罗；但义人必脱离患难。

verses.en: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth. The work of a man’s hands shall be rewarded to him.
verses.zh: 人因口所结的果子，必饱得美福；人手所做的，必为自己的报应。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.en: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but he who is wise listens to counsel.
verses.zh: 愚妄人所行的，在自己眼中看为正直；惟智慧人肯听人的劝教。

verses.en: A fool shows his annoyance the same day, but one who overlooks an insult is prudent.
verses.zh: 愚妄人的恼怒立时显露；通达人能忍辱藏羞。

verses.en: He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.
verses.zh: 说出真话的，显明公义；作假见证的，显出诡诈。

words.g: to puff, i.e. blow with the breath or air

verses.en: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.
verses.zh: 说话浮躁的，如刀刺人；智慧人的舌头却为医人的良药。

verses.en: Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.
verses.zh: 口吐真言，永远坚立；舌说谎话，只存片时。

verses.en: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil, but joy comes to the promoters of peace.
verses.zh: 图谋恶事的，心存诡诈；劝人和睦的，便得喜乐。

verses.en: No mischief shall happen to the righteous, but the wicked shall be filled with evil.
verses.zh: 义人不遭灾害；恶人满受祸患。

verses.en: Lying lips are an abomination to the LORD, but those who do the truth are his delight.
verses.zh: 说谎言的嘴为耶和华所憎恶；行事诚实的，为他所喜悦。

verses.en: A prudent man keeps his knowledge, but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness.
verses.zh: 通达人隐藏知识；愚昧人的心彰显愚昧。

verses.en: The hands of the diligent ones shall rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.
verses.zh: 殷勤人的手必掌权；懒惰的人必服苦。

words.g: to + a burden , i.e. a tax in the form of forced labor

verses.en: Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.
verses.zh: 人心忧虑，屈而不伸；一句良言，使心欢乐。

verses.en: A righteous person is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.
verses.zh: 义人引导他的邻舍；恶人的道叫人失迷。

words.g: to meander  about, especially fortrade or reconnoitring
to vacillate, i.e. reel or stray + +them/their

verses.en: The slothful man doesn’t roast his game, but the possessions of diligent men are prized.
verses.zh: 懒惰的人不烤打猎所得的；殷勤的人却得宝贵的财物。

words.g: to braid  or catch  in anet

verses.en: In the way of righteousness is life; in its path there is no death.
verses.zh: 在公义的道上有生命；其路之中并无死亡。

verses.en: A wise son listens to his father’s instruction, but a scoffer doesn’t listen to rebuke.
verses.zh: 智慧子听父亲的教训；亵慢人不听责备。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate

verses.en: By the fruit of his lips, a man enjoys good things, but the unfaithful crave violence.
verses.zh: 人因口所结的果子，必享美福；奸诈人必遭强暴。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.en: He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.
verses.zh: 谨守口的，得保生命；大张嘴的，必致败亡。

words.g: to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one
the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +him/his/it

verses.en: The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.
verses.zh: 懒惰人羡慕，却无所得；殷勤人必得丰裕。

verses.en: A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.
verses.zh: 义人恨恶谎言；恶人有臭名，且致惭愧。

verses.en: Righteousness guards the way of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.
verses.zh: 行为正直的，有公义保守；犯罪的，被邪恶倾覆。

words.g: to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one

verses.en: There are some who pretend to be rich, yet have nothing. There are some who pretend to be poor, yet have great wealth.
verses.zh: 假作富足的，却一无所有；装作穷乏的，却广有财物。

verses.en: The ransom of a man’s life is his riches, but the poor hear no threats.
verses.zh: 人的资财是他生命的赎价；穷乏人却听不见威吓的话。

verses.en: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.
verses.zh: 义人的光明亮（原文是欢喜）；恶人的灯要熄灭。

verses.en: Pride only breeds quarrels, but wisdom is with people who take advice.
verses.zh: 骄傲只启争竞；听劝言的，却有智慧。

verses.en: Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away, but he who gathers by hand makes it grow.
verses.zh: 不劳而得之财必然消耗；勤劳积蓄的，必见加增。

verses.en: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.
verses.zh: 所盼望的迟延未得，令人心忧；所愿意的临到，却是生命树。

words.g: to draw, used in a great variety of applications

verses.en: Whoever despises instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command will be rewarded.
verses.zh: 藐视训言的，自取灭亡；敬畏诫命的，必得善报。

words.g: to wind tightly , i.e. to bind
a command, whether human or divine

verses.en: The teaching of the wise is a spring of life, to turn from the snares of death.
verses.zh: 智慧人的法则（或译：指教）是生命的泉源，可以使人离开死亡的网罗。

verses.en: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful is hard.
verses.zh: 美好的聪明使人蒙恩；奸诈人的道路崎岖难行。

verses.en: Every prudent man acts from knowledge, but a fool exposes folly.
verses.zh: 凡通达人都凭知识行事；愚昧人张扬自己的愚昧。

words.g: and + fat, i.e.  stupid or silly

verses.en: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.
verses.zh: 奸恶的使者必陷在祸患里；忠信的使臣乃医人的良药。

verses.en: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline, but he who heeds correction shall be honored.
verses.zh: 弃绝管教的，必致贫受辱；领受责备的，必得尊荣。

verses.en: Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.
verses.zh: 所欲的成就，心觉甘甜；远离恶事，为愚昧人所憎恶。

words.g: and + something disgusting , i.e.  an abhorrence

verses.en: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
verses.zh: 与智慧人同行的，必得智慧；和愚昧人作伴的，必受亏损。

verses.en: Misfortune pursues sinners, but prosperity rewards the righteous.
verses.zh: 祸患追赶罪人；义人必得善报。

verses.en: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.
verses.zh: 善人给子孙遗留产业；罪人为义人积存资财。

words.g: to inherit  mode of descent), or  to occupy
probably a force, whether of men

verses.en: An abundance of food is in poor people’s fields, but injustice sweeps it away.
verses.zh: 穷人耕种多得粮食，但因不义，有消灭的。

verses.en: One who spares the rod hates his son, but one who loves him is careful to discipline him.
verses.zh: 不忍用杖打儿子的，是恨恶他；疼爱儿子的，随时管教。

words.g: to dawn, i.e.  be  early at any task + +him/his/it

verses.en: The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul, but the belly of the wicked goes hungry.
verses.zh: 义人吃得饱足；恶人肚腹缺粮。

verses.en: Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.
verses.zh: 智慧妇人建立家室；愚妄妇人亲手拆毁。

words.g: to pull down or in pieces, break + +him/his/it

verses.en: He who walks in his uprightness fears the LORD, but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.
verses.zh: 行动正直的，敬畏耶和华；行事乖僻的，却藐视他。

words.g: and + to turn aside , i.e.  to depart

verses.en: The fool’s talk brings a rod to his back, but the lips of the wise protect them.
verses.zh: 愚妄人口中骄傲，如杖责打己身；智慧人的嘴必保守自己。

words.g: in + the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.en: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean, but much increase is by the strength of the ox.
verses.zh: 家里无牛，槽头干净；土产加多乃凭牛力。

verses.en: A truthful witness will not lie, but a false witness pours out lies.
verses.zh: 诚实见证人不说谎话；假见证人吐出谎言。

words.g: and + to puff, i.e. blow with the breath or air

verses.en: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.
verses.zh: 亵慢人寻智慧，却寻不着；聪明人易得知识。

words.g: to + to separate mentally , i.e. understand

verses.en: Stay away from a foolish man, for you won’t find knowledge on his lips.
verses.zh: 到愚昧人面前，不见他嘴中有知识。

verses.en: The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.
verses.zh: 通达人的智慧在乎明白己道；愚昧人的愚妄乃是诡诈（或译：自欺）。

verses.en: Fools mock at making atonement for sins, but among the upright there is good will.
verses.zh: 愚妄人犯罪，以为戏耍（或译：赎愆祭愚弄愚妄人）；正直人互相喜悦。

verses.en: The heart knows its own bitterness and joy; he will not share these with a stranger.
verses.zh: 心中的苦楚，自己知道；心里的喜乐，外人无干。

verses.en: The house of the wicked will be overthrown, but the tent of the upright will flourish.
verses.zh: 奸恶人的房屋必倾倒；正直人的帐棚必兴盛。

words.g: to break forth as a bud, i.e. bloom

verses.en: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.
verses.zh: 有一条路，人以为正，至终成为死亡之路。

words.g: and + the last or end, hence + +her/its

verses.en: Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful, and mirth may end in heaviness.
verses.zh: 人在喜笑中，心也忧愁；快乐至极就生愁苦。

words.g: and + the last or end, hence + +her/its

verses.en: The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.
verses.zh: 心中背道的，必满得自己的结果；善人必从自己的行为得以知足。

words.g: to flinch, i.e.  to go back

verses.en: A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.
verses.zh: 愚蒙人是话都信；通达人步步谨慎。

verses.en: A wise man fears and shuns evil, but the fool is hot headed and reckless.
verses.zh: 智慧人惧怕，就远离恶事；愚妄人却狂傲自恃。

words.g: and + fat, i.e.  stupid or silly

verses.en: He who is quick to become angry will commit folly, and a crafty man is hated.
verses.zh: 轻易发怒的，行事愚妄；设立诡计的，被人恨恶。

verses.en: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
verses.zh: 愚蒙人得愚昧为产业；通达人得知识为冠冕。

words.g: to inherit  mode of descent), or  to occupy

verses.en: The evil bow down before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
verses.zh: 坏人俯伏在善人面前；恶人俯伏在义人门口。

verses.en: The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends.
verses.zh: 贫穷人连邻舍也恨他；富足人朋友最多。

verses.en: He who despises his neighbor sins, but he who has pity on the poor is blessed.
verses.zh: 藐视邻舍的，这人有罪；怜悯贫穷的，这人有福。

verses.en: Don’t they go astray who plot evil? But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good.
verses.zh: 谋恶的，岂非走入迷途吗？谋善的，必得慈爱和诚实。

words.g: to vacillate, i.e. reel or stray

verses.en: In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.
verses.zh: 诸般勤劳都有益处；嘴上多言乃致穷乏。

verses.en: The crown of the wise is their riches, but the folly of fools crowns them with folly.
verses.zh: 智慧人的财为自己的冠冕；愚妄人的愚昧终是愚昧。

verses.en: A truthful witness saves souls, but a false witness is deceitful.
verses.zh: 作真见证的，救人性命；吐出谎言的，施行诡诈。

words.g: and + to puff, i.e. blow with the breath or air

verses.en: In the fear of the LORD is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.
verses.zh: 敬畏耶和华的，大有倚靠；他的儿女也有避难所。

verses.en: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, turning people from the snares of death.
verses.zh: 敬畏耶和华就是生命的泉源，可以使人离开死亡的网罗。

verses.en: In the multitude of people is the king’s glory, but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince.
verses.zh: 帝王荣耀在乎民多；君王衰败在乎民少。

words.g: and + in + cessation, i.e. an end

verses.en: He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.
verses.zh: 不轻易发怒的，大有聪明；性情暴躁的，大显愚妄。

words.g: to be high actively, to rise or raise

verses.en: The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.
verses.zh: 心中安静是肉体的生命；嫉妒是骨中的朽烂。

verses.en: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.
verses.zh: 欺压贫寒的，是辱没造他的主；怜悯穷乏的，乃是尊敬主。

words.g: to pull off, i.e.  to expose

verses.en: The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.
verses.zh: 恶人在所行的恶上必被推倒；义人临死，有所投靠。

verses.en: Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding, and is even made known in the inward part of fools.
verses.zh: 智慧存在聪明人心中；愚昧人心里所存的，显而易见。

words.g: and + in + the nearest part, i.e. the center

verses.en: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.
verses.zh: 公义使邦国高举；罪恶是人民的羞辱。

words.g: to be high actively, to rise or raise

verses.en: The king’s favor is toward a servant who deals wisely, but his wrath is toward one who causes shame.
verses.zh: 智慧的臣子蒙王恩惠；贻羞的仆人遭其震怒。

words.g: to be  circumspect and hence, intelligent
to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed

verses.en: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
verses.zh: 回答柔和，使怒消退；言语暴戾，触动怒气。

verses.en: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouths of fools gush out folly.
verses.zh: 智慧人的舌善发知识；愚昧人的口吐出愚昧。

words.g: and + the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.en: The LORD’s eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.
verses.zh: 耶和华的眼目无处不在；恶人善人，他都鉴察。

words.g: to lean forward, i.e. to peer into the distance

verses.en: A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but deceit in it crushes the spirit.
verses.zh: 温良的舌是生命树；乖谬的嘴使人心碎。

verses.en: A fool despises his father’s correction, but he who heeds reproof shows prudence.
verses.zh: 愚妄人藐视父亲的管教；领受责备的，得着见识。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate + +him/his/it

verses.en: In the house of the righteous is much treasure, but the income of the wicked brings trouble.
verses.zh: 义人家中多有财宝；恶人得利反受扰害。

verses.en: The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.
verses.zh: 智慧人的嘴播扬知识；愚昧人的心并不如此。

verses.en: The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
verses.zh: 恶人献祭，为耶和华所憎恶；正直人祈祷，为他所喜悦。

verses.en: The way of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, but he loves him who follows after righteousness.
verses.zh: 恶人的道路，为耶和华所憎恶；追求公义的，为他所喜爱。

verses.en: There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way. Whoever hates reproof shall die.
verses.zh: 舍弃正路的，必受严刑；恨恶责备的，必致死亡。

verses.en: Sheol and Abaddon are before the LORD— how much more then the hearts of the children of men!
verses.zh: 阴间和灭亡尚在耶和华眼前，何况世人的心呢？

verses.en: A scoffer doesn’t love to be reproved; he will not go to the wise.
verses.zh: 亵慢人不爱受责备；他也不就近智慧人。

verses.en: A glad heart makes a cheerful face, but an aching heart breaks the spirit.
verses.zh: 心中喜乐，面带笑容；心里忧愁，灵被损伤。

verses.en: The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouths of fools feed on folly.
verses.zh: 聪明人心求知识；愚昧人口吃愚昧。

words.g: and + the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.en: All the days of the afflicted are wretched, but one who has a cheerful heart enjoys a continual feast.
verses.zh: 困苦人的日子都是愁苦；心中欢畅的，常享丰筵。

verses.en: Better is little, with the fear of the LORD, than great treasure with trouble.
verses.zh: 少有财宝，敬畏耶和华，强如多有财宝，烦乱不安。

verses.en: Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, than a fattened calf with hatred.
verses.zh: 吃素菜，彼此相爱，强如吃肥牛，彼此相恨。

verses.en: A wrathful man stirs up contention, but one who is slow to anger appeases strife.
verses.zh: 暴怒的人挑启争端；忍怒的人止息纷争。

verses.en: The way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch, but the path of the upright is a highway.
verses.zh: 懒惰人的道像荆棘的篱笆；正直人的路是平坦的大道。

verses.en: A wise son makes a father glad, but a foolish man despises his mother.
verses.zh: 智慧子使父亲喜乐；愚昧人藐视母亲。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate
and + fat, i.e.  stupid or silly

verses.en: Folly is joy to one who is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding keeps his way straight.
verses.zh: 无知的人以愚妄为乐；聪明的人按正直而行。

verses.en: Where there is no counsel, plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.
verses.zh: 不先商议，所谋无效；谋士众多，所谋乃成。

words.g: to break up , i.e. to violate

verses.en: Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time!
verses.zh: 口善应对，自觉喜乐；话合其时，何等美好。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +him/his/it

verses.en: The path of life leads upward for the wise, to keep him from going downward to Sheol.
verses.zh: 智慧人从生命的道上升，使他远离在下的阴间。

words.g: to + the upper part, used only adverbially with prefix upward
to + to be  circumspect and hence, intelligent

verses.en: The LORD will uproot the house of the proud, but he will keep the widow’s borders intact.
verses.zh: 耶和华必拆毁骄傲人的家，却要立定寡妇的地界。

words.g: and + to station, in various applications

verses.en: The LORD detests the thoughts of the wicked, but the thoughts of the pure are pleasing.
verses.zh: 恶谋为耶和华所憎恶；良言乃为纯净。

verses.en: He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, but he who hates bribes will live.
verses.zh: 贪恋财利的，扰害己家；恨恶贿赂的，必得存活。

words.g: to live, whether literally or figuratively

verses.en: The heart of the righteous weighs answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil.
verses.zh: 义人的心，思量如何回答；恶人的口吐出恶言。

words.g: and + the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.en: The LORD is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.
verses.zh: 耶和华远离恶人，却听义人的祷告。

verses.en: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart. Good news gives health to the bones.
verses.zh: 眼有光，使心喜乐；好信息，使骨滋润。

verses.en: The ear that listens to reproof lives, and will be at home among the wise.
verses.zh: 听从生命责备的，必常在智慧人中。

words.g: in + the nearest part, i.e. the center

verses.en: He who refuses correction despises his own soul, but he who listens to reproof gets understanding.
verses.zh: 弃绝管教的，轻看自己的生命；听从责备的，却得智慧。

verses.en: The fear of the LORD teaches wisdom. Before honor is humility.
verses.zh: 敬畏耶和华是智慧的训诲；尊荣以前，必有谦卑。

words.g: weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from the LORD.
verses.zh: 心中的谋算在乎人；舌头的应对由于耶和华。

verses.en: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the motives.
verses.zh: 人一切所行的，在自己眼中看为清洁；惟有耶和华衡量人心。

words.g: and + to balance, i.e. measure out

verses.en: Commit your deeds to the LORD, and your plans shall succeed.
verses.zh: 你所做的，要交托耶和华，你所谋的，就必成立。

verses.en: The LORD has made everything for its own end— yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.
verses.zh: 耶和华所造的，各适其用；就是恶人也为祸患的日子所造。

words.g: to do or make , especially to practise

verses.en: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD; they shall certainly not be unpunished.
verses.zh: 凡心里骄傲的，为耶和华所憎恶；虽然连手，他必不免受罚。

verses.en: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of the LORD men depart from evil.
verses.zh: 因怜悯诚实，罪孽得赎；敬畏耶和华的，远离恶事。

verses.en: When a man’s ways please the LORD, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.
verses.zh: 人所行的，若蒙耶和华喜悦，耶和华也使他的仇敌与他和好。

verses.en: Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.
verses.zh: 多有财利，行事不义，不如少有财利，行事公义。

verses.en: A man’s heart plans his course, but the LORD directs his steps.
verses.zh: 人心筹算自己的道路；惟耶和华指引他的脚步。

verses.en: Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king. He shall not betray his mouth.
verses.zh: 王的嘴中有神语，审判之时，他的口必不差错。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +him/his/it

verses.en: Honest balances and scales are the LORD’s; all the weights in the bag are his work.
verses.zh: 公道的天平和秤都属耶和华；囊中一切法码都为他所定。

verses.en: It is an abomination for kings to do wrong, for the throne is established by righteousness.
verses.zh: 作恶，为王所憎恶，因国位是靠公义坚立。

verses.en: Righteous lips are the delight of kings. They value one who speaks the truth.
verses.zh: 公义的嘴为王所喜悦；说正直话的，为王所喜爱。

verses.en: The king’s wrath is a messenger of death, but a wise man will pacify it.
verses.zh: 王的震怒如杀人的使者；但智慧人能止息王怒。

verses.en: In the light of the king’s face is life. His favor is like a cloud of the spring rain.
verses.zh: 王的脸光使人有生命；王的恩典好像春云时雨。

verses.en: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.
verses.zh: 得智慧胜似得金子；选聪明强如选银子。

verses.en: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.
verses.zh: 正直人的道是远离恶事；谨守己路的，是保全性命。

words.g: to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one

verses.en: Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.
verses.zh: 骄傲在败坏以先；狂心在跌倒之前。

verses.en: It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, than to divide the plunder with the proud.
verses.zh: 心里谦卑与穷乏人来往，强如将掳物与骄傲人同分。

verses.en: He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in the LORD is blessed.
verses.zh: 谨守训言的，必得好处；倚靠耶和华的，便为有福。

words.g: to be  circumspect and hence, intelligent

verses.en: The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.
verses.zh: 心中有智慧，必称为通达人；嘴中的甜言，加增人的学问。

verses.en: Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it, but the punishment of fools is their folly.
verses.zh: 人有智慧就有生命的泉源；愚昧人必被愚昧惩治。

verses.en: The heart of the wise instructs his mouth, and adds learning to his lips.
verses.zh: 智慧人的心教训他的口，又使他的嘴增长学问。

words.g: to be  circumspect and hence, intelligent
the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +him/his/it

verses.en: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
verses.zh: 良言如同蜂房，使心觉甘甜，使骨得医治。

words.g: and + curative, i.e. literally  a medicine

verses.en: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.
verses.zh: 有一条路，人以为正，至终成为死亡之路。

words.g: and + the last or end, hence + +her/its

verses.en: The appetite of the laboring man labors for him, for his mouth urges him on.
verses.zh: 劳力人的胃口使他劳力，因为他的口腹催逼他。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +him/his/it

verses.en: A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire.
verses.zh: 匪徒图谋奸恶，嘴上彷佛有烧焦的火。

verses.en: A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends.
verses.zh: 乖僻人播散纷争；传舌的，离间密友。

words.g: to break through, i.e. spread or separate

verses.en: A man of violence entices his neighbor, and leads him in a way that is not good.
verses.zh: 强暴人诱惑邻舍，领他走不善之道。

verses.en: One who winks his eyes to plot perversities, one who compresses his lips, is bent on evil.
verses.zh: 眼目紧合的，图谋乖僻；嘴唇紧闭的，成就邪恶。

words.g: to pinch, i.e.  to bite the lips
to end, whether intransitive  or transitived

verses.en: Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.
verses.zh: 白发是荣耀的冠冕，在公义的道上必能得着。

verses.en: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.
verses.zh: 不轻易发怒的，胜过勇士；治服己心的，强如取城。

verses.en: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from the LORD.
verses.zh: 签放在怀里，定事由耶和华。

verses.en: Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of feasting with strife.
verses.zh: 设筵满屋，大家相争，不如有块干饼，大家相安。

verses.en: A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who causes shame, and shall have a part in the inheritance among the brothers.
verses.zh: 仆人办事聪明，必管辖贻羞之子，又在众子中同分产业。

words.g: to be  circumspect and hence, intelligent
to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed

verses.en: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold, but the LORD tests the hearts.
verses.zh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金；惟有耶和华熬炼人心。

verses.en: An evildoer heeds wicked lips. A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.
verses.zh: 行恶的，留心听奸诈之言；说谎的，侧耳听邪恶之语。

words.g: to prick up the ears, i.e. hearken
to broaden out the ear , i.e.  to listen

verses.en: Whoever mocks the poor reproaches his Maker. He who is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.
verses.zh: 戏笑穷人的，是辱没造他的主；幸灾乐祸的，必不免受罚。

words.g: to pull off, i.e.  to expose

verses.en: Children’s children are the crown of old men; the glory of children is their parents.
verses.zh: 子孙为老人的冠冕；父亲是儿女的荣耀。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate + +them/their

verses.en: Excellent speech isn’t fitting for a fool, much less do lying lips fit a prince.
verses.zh: 愚顽人说美言本不相宜，何况君王说谎话呢？

verses.en: A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it; wherever he turns, he prospers.
verses.zh: 贿赂在馈送的人眼中看为宝玉，随处运动都得顺利。

words.g: to be  circumspect and hence, intelligent

verses.en: He who covers an offense promotes love; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.
verses.zh: 遮掩人过的，寻求人爱；屡次挑错的，离间密友。

words.g: to break through, i.e. spread or separate

verses.en: A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.
verses.zh: 一句责备话深入聪明人的心，强如责打愚昧人一百下。

words.g: in + to separate mentally , i.e. understand

verses.en: An evil man seeks only rebellion; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
verses.zh: 恶人只寻背叛，所以必有严厉的使者奉差攻击他。

verses.en: Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
verses.zh: 宁可遇见丢崽子的母熊，不可遇见正行愚妄的愚昧人。

words.g: to come in contact with, whether by accident or violence

verses.en: Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
verses.zh: 以恶报善的，祸患必不离他的家。

verses.en: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam, therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out.
verses.zh: 纷争的起头如水放开，所以，在争闹之先必当止息争竞。

words.g: to cleave or burst through, i.e.  to emit

verses.en: He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous, both of them alike are an abomination to the LORD.
verses.zh: 定恶人为义的，定义人为恶的，这都为耶和华所憎恶。

verses.en: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?
verses.zh: 愚昧人既无聪明，为何手拿价银买智慧呢？

verses.en: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.
verses.zh: 朋友乃时常亲爱，弟兄为患难而生。

verses.en: A man void of understanding strikes hands, and becomes collateral in the presence of his neighbor.
verses.zh: 在邻舍面前击掌作保乃是无知的人。

words.g: something given as security, i.e.  a token  or  a bondsman

verses.en: He who loves disobedience loves strife. One who builds a high gate seeks destruction.
verses.zh: 喜爱争竞的，是喜爱过犯；高立家门的，乃自取败坏。

words.g: an opening , i.e. door  or entrance way + +him/his/it

verses.en: One who has a perverse heart doesn’t find prosperity, and one who has a deceitful tongue falls into trouble.
verses.zh: 心存邪僻的，寻不着好处；舌弄是非的，陷在祸患中。

verses.en: He who becomes the father of a fool grieves. The father of a fool has no joy.
verses.zh: 生愚昧子的，必自愁苦；愚顽人的父毫无喜乐。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate

verses.en: A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.
verses.zh: 喜乐的心乃是良药；忧伤的灵使骨枯干。

verses.en: A wicked man receives a bribe in secret, to pervert the ways of justice.
verses.zh: 恶人暗中受贿赂，为要颠倒判断。

words.g: to + to stretch or spread out

verses.en: Wisdom is before the face of one who has understanding, but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth.
verses.zh: 明哲人眼前有智慧；愚昧人眼望地极。

verses.en: A foolish son brings grief to his father, and bitterness to her who bore him.
verses.zh: 愚昧子使父亲愁烦，使母亲忧苦。

words.g: to + father, in a literal and immediate + +him/his/it

verses.en: Also to punish the righteous is not good, nor to flog officials for their integrity.
verses.zh: 刑罚义人为不善；责打君子为不义。

verses.en: He who spares his words has knowledge. He who is even tempered is a man of understanding.
verses.zh: 寡少言语的，有知识；性情温良的，有聪明。

verses.en: Even a fool, when he keeps silent, is counted wise. When he shuts his lips, he is thought to be discerning.
verses.zh: 愚昧人若静默不言也可算为智慧；闭口不说也可算为聪明。

verses.en: A man who isolates himself pursues selfishness, and defies all sound judgment.
verses.zh: 与众寡合的，独自寻求心愿，并恼恨一切真智慧。

words.g: to break through, i.e. spread or separate

verses.en: A fool has no delight in understanding, but only in revealing his own opinion.
verses.zh: 愚昧人不喜爱明哲，只喜爱显露心意。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: When wickedness comes, contempt also comes, and with shame comes disgrace.
verses.zh: 恶人来，藐视随来；羞耻到，辱骂同到。

verses.en: The words of a man’s mouth are like deep waters. The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook.
verses.zh: 人口中的言语如同深水；智慧的泉源好像涌流的河水。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative
a stream, especially a winter torrent

verses.en: To be partial to the faces of the wicked is not good, nor to deprive the innocent of justice.
verses.zh: 瞻徇恶人的情面，偏断义人的案件，都为不善。

words.g: to + to stretch or spread out

verses.en: A fool’s lips come into strife, and his mouth invites beatings.
verses.zh: 愚昧人张嘴启争端，开口招鞭打。

words.g: and + the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +him/his/it

verses.en: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are a snare to his soul.
verses.zh: 愚昧人的口自取败坏；他的嘴是他生命的网罗。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.en: The words of a gossip are like dainty morsels: they go down into a person’s innermost parts.
verses.zh: 传舌人的言语如同美食，深入人的心腹。

words.g: like + to burn in, i.e.  to rankle

verses.en: One who is slack in his work is brother to him who is a master of destruction.
verses.zh: 做工懈怠的，与浪费人为弟兄。

verses.en: The LORD’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.
verses.zh: 耶和华的名是坚固台；义人奔入便得安稳。

words.g: and + to set on high, protect

verses.en: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, like an unscalable wall in his own imagination.
verses.zh: 富足人的财物是他的坚城，在他心想，犹如高墙。

words.g: and + like + a wall of protection

verses.en: Before destruction the heart of man is proud, but before honor is humility.
verses.zh: 败坏之先，人心骄傲；尊荣以前，必有谦卑。

words.g: weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: He who answers before he hears, that is folly and shame to him.
verses.zh: 未曾听完先回答的，便是他的愚昧和羞辱。

verses.en: A man’s spirit will sustain him in sickness, but a crushed spirit, who can bear?
verses.zh: 人有疾病，心能忍耐；心灵忧伤，谁能承当呢？

verses.en: The heart of the discerning gets knowledge. The ear of the wise seeks knowledge.
verses.zh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

verses.en: A man’s gift makes room for him, and brings him before great men.
verses.zh: 人的礼物为他开路，引他到高位的人面前。

verses.en: He who pleads his cause first seems right— until another comes and questions him.
verses.zh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

verses.en: The lot settles disputes, and keeps strong ones apart.
verses.zh: 掣签能止息争竞，也能解散强胜的人。

words.g: to repose, i.e. desist from exertion
to break through, i.e. spread or separate

verses.en: A brother offended is more difficult than a fortified city. Disputes are like the bars of a fortress.
verses.zh: 弟兄结怨，劝他和好，比取坚固城还难；这样的争竞如同坚寨的门闩。

verses.en: A man’s stomach is filled with the fruit of his mouth. With the harvest of his lips he is satisfied.
verses.zh: 人口中所结的果子，必充满肚腹；他嘴所出的，必使他饱足。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.en: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.
verses.zh: 生死在舌头的权下，喜爱它的，必吃它所结的果子。

verses.en: Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favor of the LORD.
verses.zh: 得着贤妻的，是得着好处，也是蒙了耶和华的恩惠。

verses.en: The poor plead for mercy, but the rich answer harshly.
verses.zh: 贫穷人说哀求的话；富足人用威吓的话回答。

words.g: and + rich, whether literal or figurative

verses.en: A man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.
verses.zh: 滥交朋友的，自取败坏；但有一朋友比弟兄更亲密。

verses.en: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.
verses.zh: 行为纯正的贫穷人胜过乖谬愚妄的富足人。

verses.en: It isn’t good to have zeal without knowledge, nor to be hasty with one’s feet and miss the way.
verses.zh: 心无知识的，乃为不善；脚步急快的，难免犯罪。

verses.en: The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against the LORD.
verses.zh: 人的愚昧倾败他的道；他的心也抱怨耶和华。

words.g: to boil up, i.e.  to be peevish or angry

verses.en: Wealth adds many friends, but the poor is separated from his friend.
verses.zh: 财物使朋友增多；但穷人朋友远离。

words.g: and + dangling, i.e.  weak or thin
to break through, i.e. spread or separate

verses.en: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free.
verses.zh: 作假见证的，必不免受罚；吐出谎言的，终不能逃脱。

words.g: and + to puff, i.e. blow with the breath or air
to be smooth, i.e.  to escape

verses.en: Many will entreat the favor of a ruler, and everyone is a friend to a man who gives gifts.
verses.zh: 好施散的，有多人求他的恩情；爱送礼的，人都为他的朋友。

verses.en: All the relatives of the poor shun him; how much more do his friends avoid him! He pursues them with pleas, but they are gone.
verses.zh: 贫穷人，弟兄都恨他；何况他的朋友，更远离他！他用言语追随，他们却走了。

words.g: to widen , i.e.  recede or  remove

verses.en: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul. He who keeps understanding shall find good.
verses.zh: 得着智慧的，爱惜生命；保守聪明的，必得好处。

verses.en: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who utters lies shall perish.
verses.zh: 作假见证的，不免受罚；吐出谎言的，也必灭亡。

words.g: and + to puff, i.e. blow with the breath or air

verses.en: Delicate living is not appropriate for a fool, much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
verses.zh: 愚昧人宴乐度日是不合宜的；何况仆人管辖王子呢？

words.g: to + fat, i.e.  stupid or silly

verses.en: The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense.
verses.zh: 人有见识就不轻易发怒；宽恕人的过失便是自己的荣耀。

verses.en: The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.
verses.zh: 王的忿怒好像狮子吼叫；他的恩典却如草上的甘露。

verses.en: A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife’s quarrels are a continual dripping.
verses.zh: 愚昧的儿子是父亲的祸患；妻子的争吵如雨连连滴漏。

words.g: to + father, in a literal and immediate + +him/his/it

verses.en: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers, but a prudent wife is from the LORD.
verses.zh: 房屋钱财是祖宗所遗留的；惟有贤慧的妻是耶和华所赐的。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate
to be  circumspect and hence, intelligent

verses.en: Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep. The idle soul shall suffer hunger.
verses.zh: 懒惰使人沉睡；懈怠的人必受饥饿。

verses.en: He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, but he who is contemptuous in his ways shall die.
verses.zh: 谨守诫命的，保全生命；轻忽己路的，必致死亡。

words.g: a command, whether human or divine

verses.en: He who has pity on the poor lends to the LORD; he will reward him.
verses.zh: 怜悯贫穷的，就是借给耶和华；他的善行，耶和华必偿还。

verses.en: Discipline your son, for there is hope; don’t be a willing party to his death.
verses.zh: 趁有指望，管教你的儿子；你的心不可任他死亡。

verses.en: A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty, for if you rescue him, you must do it again.
verses.zh: 暴怒的人必受刑罚；你若救他，必须再救。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.
verses.zh: 你要听劝教，受训诲，使你终久有智慧。

words.g: in + the last or end, hence + +you/your

verses.en: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but the LORD’s counsel will prevail.
verses.zh: 人心多有计谋；惟有耶和华的筹算才能立定。

verses.en: That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness. A poor man is better than a liar.
verses.zh: 施行仁慈的，令人爱慕；穷人强如说谎言的。

verses.en: The fear of the LORD leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.
verses.zh: 敬畏耶和华的，得着生命；他必恒久知足，不遭祸患。

verses.en: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
verses.zh: 懒惰人放手在盘子里，就是向口撤回，他也不肯。

words.g: in + something advanced or deep, i.e. a bowl
the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +him/his/it

verses.en: Flog a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke one who has understanding, and he will gain knowledge.
verses.zh: 鞭打亵慢人，愚蒙人必长见识；责备明哲人，他就明白知识。

words.g: to + to separate mentally , i.e. understand

verses.en: He who robs his father and drives away his mother is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.
verses.zh: 虐待父亲、撵出母亲的，是贻羞致辱之子。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate
to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed

verses.en: If you stop listening to instruction, my son, you will stray from the words of knowledge.
verses.zh: 我儿，不可听了教训而又偏离知识的言语。

words.g: to + to stray , usually  to mistake

verses.en: A corrupt witness mocks justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down iniquity.
verses.zh: 匪徒作见证戏笑公平；恶人的口吞下罪孽。

words.g: and + the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.en: Penalties are prepared for scoffers, and beatings for the backs of fools.
verses.zh: 刑罚是为亵慢人预备的；鞭打是为愚昧人的背预备的。

verses.en: Wine is a mocker and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.
verses.zh: 酒能使人亵慢，浓酒使人喧嚷；凡因酒错误的，就无智慧。

words.g: an intoxicant, i.e. intensely alcoholic liquor

verses.en: The terror of a king is like the roaring of a lion. He who provokes him to anger forfeits his own life.
verses.zh: 王的威吓如同狮子吼叫；惹动他怒的，是自害己命。

verses.en: It is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife, but every fool will be quarreling.
