verses.zh: 远离纷争是人的尊荣；愚妄人都爱争闹。

words.g: weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.
verses.zh: 懒惰人因冬寒不肯耕种，到收割的时候，他必讨饭而无所得。

words.g: from + the crop gathered, i.e.  the autumn  season

verses.en: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water, but a man of understanding will draw it out.
verses.zh: 人心怀藏谋略，好像深水，惟明哲人才能汲引出来。

words.g: to dangle, i.e. to let down abucket + +her/its

verses.en: Many men claim to be men of unfailing love, but who can find a faithful man?
verses.zh: 人多述说自己的仁慈，但忠信人谁能遇着呢？

verses.en: A righteous man walks in integrity. Blessed are his children after him.
verses.zh: 行为纯正的义人，他的子孙是有福的！

verses.en: A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.
verses.zh: 王坐在审判的位上，以眼目驱散诸恶。

verses.en: Who can say, “I have made my heart pure. I am clean and without sin”?
verses.zh: 谁能说，我洁净了我的心，我脱净了我的罪？

words.g: from + an offence , and its penalty + +me/my

verses.en: Differing weights and differing measures, both of them alike are an abomination to the LORD.
verses.zh: 两样的法码，两样的升斗，都为耶和华所憎恶。

words.g: an ephah or measure for grain
and + an ephah or measure for grain

verses.en: Even a child makes himself known by his doings, whether his work is pure, and whether it is right.
verses.zh: 孩童的动作是清洁，是正直，都显明他的本性。

words.g: to scrutinize, i.e. look intently at
a boy , from the age of infancy to adolescence
used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
and + used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the LORD has made even both of them.
verses.zh: 能听的耳，能看的眼，都是耶和华所造的。

verses.en: Don’t love sleep, lest you come to poverty. Open your eyes, and you shall be satisfied with bread.
verses.zh: 不要贪睡，免致贫穷；眼要睁开，你就吃饱。

verses.en: “It’s no good, it’s no good,” says the buyer; but when he is gone his way, then he boasts.
verses.zh: 买物的说：不好，不好；及至买去，他便自夸。

verses.en: There is gold and abundance of rubies, but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.
verses.zh: 有金子和许多珍珠（或译：红宝石），惟有知识的嘴乃为贵重的珍宝。

verses.en: Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman.
verses.zh: 谁为生人作保，就拿谁的衣服；谁为外人作保，谁就要承当。

words.g: strange, in a variety of degrees and applications
to wind tightly , i.e. to bind + +him/his/it

verses.en: Fraudulent food is sweet to a man, but afterwards his mouth is filled with gravel.
verses.zh: 以虚谎而得的食物，人觉甘甜；但后来，他的口必充满尘沙。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +him/his/it

verses.en: Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war!
verses.zh: 计谋都凭筹算立定；打仗要凭智谋。

words.g: and + in + steerage , i.e.  guidance or  a plan

verses.en: He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.
verses.zh: 往来传舌的，泄漏密事；大张嘴的，不可与他结交。

words.g: and + to + to open, i.e. be  roomy

verses.en: Whoever curses his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in blackness of darkness.
verses.zh: 咒骂父母的，他的灯必灭，变为漆黑的黑暗。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate + +him/his/it
in + the little man of the eye

verses.en: An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning won’t be blessed in the end.
verses.zh: 起初速得的产业，终久却不为福。

words.g: to tremble inwardly , i.e.  be   alarmed or agitated
and + the last or end, hence + +her/its

verses.en: Don’t say, “I will pay back evil.” Wait for the LORD, and he will save you.
verses.zh: 你不要说，我要以恶报恶；要等候耶和华，他必拯救你。

words.g: and + to be open, wide or free

verses.en: The LORD detests differing weights, and dishonest scales are not pleasing.
verses.zh: 两样的法码为耶和华所憎恶；诡诈的天平也为不善。

verses.en: A man’s steps are from the LORD; how then can man understand his way?
verses.zh: 人的脚步为耶和华所定；人岂能明白自己的路呢？

verses.en: It is a snare to a man to make a rash dedication, then later to consider his vows.
verses.zh: 人冒失说，这是圣物，许愿之后才查问，就是自陷网罗。

words.g: to + to plough, or  break forth

verses.en: A wise king winnows out the wicked, and drives the threshing wheel over them.
verses.zh: 智慧的王簸散恶人，用碌碡滚轧他们。

verses.en: The spirit of man is the LORD’s lamp, searching all his innermost parts.
verses.zh: 人的灵是耶和华的灯，鉴察人的心腹。

verses.en: Love and faithfulness keep the king safe. His throne is sustained by love.
verses.zh: 王因仁慈和诚实得以保全他的国位，也因仁慈立稳。

words.g: to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one

verses.en: The glory of young men is their strength. The splendor of old men is their gray hair.
verses.zh: 强壮乃少年人的荣耀；白发为老年人的尊荣。

words.g: and + magnificence, i.e. ornament or splendor

verses.en: Wounding blows cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the innermost parts.
verses.zh: 鞭伤除净人的罪恶；责打能入人的心腹。

words.g: a scouring, i.e. soap or perfumery forthe bath

verses.en: The king’s heart is in the LORD’s hand like the watercourses. He turns it wherever he desires.
verses.zh: 王的心在耶和华手中，好像陇沟的水随意流转。

verses.en: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the hearts.
verses.zh: 人所行的，在自己眼中都看为正；惟有耶和华衡量人心。

words.g: and + to balance, i.e. measure out

verses.en: To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.
verses.zh: 行仁义公平比献祭更蒙耶和华悦纳。

verses.en: A high look and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, is sin.
verses.zh: 恶人发达（发达：原文是灯），眼高心傲，这乃是罪。

verses.en: The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit; and everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty.
verses.zh: 殷勤筹划的，足致丰裕；行事急躁的，都必缺乏。

verses.en: Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death.
verses.zh: 用诡诈之舌求财的，就是自己取死；所得之财乃是吹来吹去的浮云。

verses.en: The violence of the wicked will drive them away, because they refuse to do what is right.
verses.zh: 恶人的强暴必将自己扫除，因他们不肯按公平行事。

verses.en: The way of the guilty is devious, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.
verses.zh: 负罪之人的路甚是弯曲；至于清洁的人，他所行的乃是正直。

verses.en: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.
verses.zh: 宁可住在房顶的角上，不在宽阔的房屋与争吵的妇人同住。

verses.en: The soul of the wicked desires evil; his neighbor finds no mercy in his eyes.
verses.zh: 恶人的心乐人受祸；他眼并不怜恤邻舍。

verses.en: When the mocker is punished, the simple gains wisdom. When the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.
verses.zh: 亵慢的人受刑罚，愚蒙的人就得智慧；智慧人受训诲，便得知识。

words.g: and + in + to be  circumspect and hence, intelligent

verses.en: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked, and brings the wicked to ruin.
verses.zh: 义人思想恶人的家，知道恶人倾倒，必致灭亡。

words.g: to be  circumspect and hence, intelligent

verses.en: Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.
verses.zh: 塞耳不听穷人哀求的，他将来呼吁也不蒙应允。

verses.en: A gift in secret pacifies anger, and a bribe in the cloak, strong wrath.
verses.zh: 暗中送的礼物挽回怒气；怀中搋的贿赂止息暴怒。

words.g: to bend, i.e.  to tame or subdue

verses.en: It is joy to the righteous to do justice; but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
verses.zh: 秉公行义使义人喜乐，使作孽的人败坏。

words.g: to + to do or make , especially to practise

verses.en: The man who wanders out of the way of understanding shall rest in the assembly of the departed spirits.
verses.zh: 迷离通达道路的，必住在阴魂的会中。

words.g: to vacillate, i.e. reel or stray
to be  circumspect and hence, intelligent

verses.en: He who loves pleasure will be a poor man. He who loves wine and oil won’t be rich.
verses.zh: 爱宴乐的，必致穷乏；好酒，爱膏油的，必不富足。

verses.en: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous, the treacherous for the upright.
verses.zh: 恶人作了义人的赎价；奸诈人代替正直人。

verses.en: It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.
verses.zh: 宁可住在旷野，不与争吵使气的妇人同住。

verses.en: There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise, but a foolish man swallows it up.
verses.zh: 智慧人家中积蓄宝物膏油；愚昧人随得来随吞下。

words.g: and + fat, i.e.  stupid or silly

verses.en: He who follows after righteousness and kindness finds life, righteousness, and honor.
verses.zh: 追求公义仁慈的，就寻得生命、公义，和尊荣。

words.g: and + weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: A wise man scales the city of the mighty, and brings down the strength of its confidence.
verses.zh: 智慧人爬上勇士的城墙，倾覆他所倚靠的坚垒。

verses.en: Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.
verses.zh: 谨守口与舌的，就保守自己免受灾难。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +him/his/it

verses.en: The proud and arrogant man—“Scoffer” is his name— he works in the arrogance of pride.
verses.zh: 心骄气傲的人名叫亵慢；他行事狂妄，都出于骄傲。

verses.en: The desire of the sluggard kills him, for his hands refuse to labor.
verses.zh: 懒惰人的心愿将他杀害，因为他手不肯做工。

verses.en: There are those who covet greedily all day long; but the righteous give and don’t withhold.
verses.zh: 有终日贪得无餍的；义人施舍而不吝惜。

verses.en: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination— how much more, when he brings it with a wicked mind!
verses.zh: 恶人的祭物是可憎的；何况他存恶意来献呢？

words.g: in + a plan, especially a bad one

verses.en: A false witness will perish. A man who listens speaks to eternity.
verses.zh: 作假见证的必灭亡；惟有听真情而言的，其言长存。

words.g: to + a goal, i.e. the bright object at adistance travelled towards

verses.en: A wicked man hardens his face; but as for the upright, he establishes his ways.
verses.zh: 恶人脸无羞耻；正直人行事坚定。

verses.en: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD.
verses.zh: 没有人能以智慧、聪明、谋略敌挡耶和华。

verses.en: The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with the LORD.
verses.zh: 马是为打仗之日预备的；得胜乃在乎耶和华。

verses.en: A good name is more desirable than great riches, and loving favor is better than silver and gold.
verses.zh: 美名胜过大财；恩宠强如金银。

verses.en: The rich and the poor have this in common: The LORD is the maker of them all.
verses.zh: 富户穷人在世相遇，都为耶和华所造。

words.g: to come in contact with, whether by accident or violence

verses.en: A prudent man sees danger and hides himself; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.
verses.zh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

words.g: and + to hide , literally or figuratively

verses.en: The result of humility and the fear of the LORD is wealth, honor, and life.
verses.zh: 敬畏耶和华心存谦卑，就得富有、尊荣、生命为赏赐。

words.g: a heel, i.e.  the last of anything
and + weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: Thorns and snares are in the path of the wicked; whoever guards his soul stays far from them.
verses.zh: 乖僻人的路上有荆棘和网罗；保守自己生命的，必要远离。

words.g: to widen , i.e.  recede or  remove

verses.en: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.
verses.zh: 教养孩童，使他走当行的道，就是到老他也不偏离。

words.g: to + a boy , from the age of infancy to adolescence
the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.en: The rich rule over the poor. The borrower is servant to the lender.
verses.zh: 富户管辖穷人；欠债的是债主的仆人。

verses.en: He who sows wickedness reaps trouble, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.
verses.zh: 撒罪孽的，必收灾祸；他逞怒的杖也必废掉。

words.g: to end, whether intransitive  or transitived

verses.en: He who has a generous eye will be blessed, for he shares his food with the poor.
verses.zh: 眼目慈善的，就必蒙福，因他将食物分给穷人。

words.g: to + dangling, i.e.  weak or thin

verses.en: Drive out the mocker, and strife will go out; yes, quarrels and insults will stop.
verses.zh: 赶出亵慢人，争端就消除；纷争和羞辱也必止息。

words.g: and + to repose, i.e. desist from exertion

verses.en: He who loves purity of heart and speaks gracefully is the king’s friend.
verses.zh: 喜爱清心的人因他嘴上的恩言，王必与他为友。

verses.en: The LORD’s eyes watch over knowledge, but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful.
verses.zh: 耶和华的眼目眷顾聪明人，却倾败奸诈人的言语。

words.g: to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one
and + to wrench, i.e.  to subvert

verses.en: The sluggard says, “There is a lion outside! I will be killed in the streets!”
verses.zh: 懒惰人说：外头有狮子；我在街上就必被杀。

words.g: in + separate by awall, i.e. outside
a width, i.e.  avenue or area
to dash in pieces, i.e. kill

verses.en: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit. He who is under the LORD’s wrath will fall into it.
verses.zh: 淫妇的口为深坑；耶和华所憎恶的，必陷在其中。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative
to foam at the mouth, i.e. to be enraged

verses.en: Folly is bound up in the heart of a child; the rod of discipline drives it far from him.
verses.zh: 愚蒙迷住孩童的心，用管教的杖可以远远赶除。

words.g: a boy , from the age of infancy to adolescence
to widen , i.e.  recede or  remove + +her/its

verses.en: Whoever oppresses the poor for his own increase and whoever gives to the rich, both come to poverty.
verses.zh: 欺压贫穷为要利己的，并送礼与富户的，都必缺乏。

words.g: to + rich, whether literal or figurative

verses.en: Turn your ear, and listen to the words of the wise. Apply your heart to my teaching.
verses.zh: 你须侧耳听受智慧人的言语，留心领会我的知识。

verses.en: For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you, if all of them are ready on your lips.
verses.zh: 你若心中存记，嘴上咬定，这便为美。

verses.en: I teach you today, even you, so that your trust may be in the LORD.
verses.zh: 我今日以此特特指教你，为要使你倚靠耶和华。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: Haven’t I written to you thirty excellent things of counsel and knowledge,
verses.zh: 谋略和知识的美事，我岂没有写给你吗？

verses.en: To teach you truth, reliable words, to give sound answers to the ones who sent you?
verses.zh: 要使你知道真言的实理，你好将真言回覆那打发你来的人。

verses.en: Don’t exploit the poor because he is poor; and don’t crush the needy in court;
verses.zh: 贫穷人，你不可因他贫穷就抢夺他的物，也不可在城门口欺压困苦人；

verses.en: for the LORD will plead their case, and plunder the life of those who plunder them.
verses.zh: 因耶和华必为他辨屈；抢夺他的，耶和华必夺取那人的命。

verses.en: Don’t befriend a hot-tempered man. Don’t associate with one who harbors anger,
verses.zh: 好生气的人，不可与他结交；暴怒的人，不可与他来往；

verses.en: lest you learn his ways and ensnare your soul.
verses.zh: 恐怕你效法他的行为，自己就陷在网罗里。

verses.en: Don’t you be one of those who strike hands, of those who are collateral for debts.
verses.zh: 不要与人击掌，不要为欠债的作保。

verses.en: If you don’t have means to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you?
verses.zh: 你若没有甚么偿还，何必使人夺去你睡卧的床呢？

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone which your fathers have set up.
verses.zh: 你先祖所立的地界，你不可挪移。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate + +you/your

verses.en: Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve kings. He won’t serve obscure men.
verses.zh: 你看见办事殷勤的人吗？他必站在君王面前，必不站在下贱人面前。

verses.en: When you sit to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before you;
verses.zh: 你若与官长坐席，要留意在你面前的是谁。

verses.en: put a knife to your throat if you are a man given to appetite.
verses.zh: 你若是贪食的，就当拿刀放在喉咙上。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: Don’t be desirous of his dainties, since they are deceitful food.
verses.zh: 不可贪恋他的美食，因为是哄人的食物。

verses.en: Don’t weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom, show restraint.
verses.zh: 不要劳碌求富，休仗自己的聪明。

verses.en: Why do you set your eyes on that which is not? For it certainly sprouts wings like an eagle and flies in the sky.
verses.zh: 你岂要定睛在虚无的钱财上吗？因钱财必长翅膀，如鹰向天飞去。

verses.en: Don’t eat the food of him who has a stingy eye, and don’t crave his delicacies,
verses.zh: 不要吃恶眼人的饭，也不要贪他的美味；

verses.en: for as he thinks about the cost, so he is. “Eat and drink!” he says to you, but his heart is not with you.
verses.zh: 因为他心怎样思量，他为人就是怎样。他虽对你说，请吃，请喝，他的心却与你相背。

words.g: a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately  as

verses.en: You will vomit up the morsel which you have eaten and waste your pleasant words.
verses.zh: 你所吃的那点食物必吐出来；你所说的甘美言语也必落空。

verses.en: Don’t speak in the ears of a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words.
verses.zh: 你不要说话给愚昧人听，因他必藐视你智慧的言语。

verses.en: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone. Don’t encroach on the fields of the fatherless,
verses.zh: 不可挪移古时的地界，也不可侵入孤儿的田地；

verses.en: for their Defender is strong. He will plead their case against you.
verses.zh: 因他们的救赎主大有能力，他必向你为他们辨屈。

words.g: to be the next of kin + +them/their

verses.en: Apply your heart to instruction, and your ears to the words of knowledge.
verses.zh: 你要留心领受训诲，侧耳听从知识的言语。

verses.en: Don’t withhold correction from a child. If you punish him with the rod, he will not die.
verses.zh: 不可不管教孩童；你用杖打他，他必不至于死。

words.g: to debar  from benefit or injury
from + a boy , from the age of infancy to adolescence

verses.en: Punish him with the rod, and save his soul from Sheol.
verses.zh: 你要用杖打他，就可以救他的灵魂免下阴间。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad, even mine.
verses.zh: 我儿，你心若存智慧，我的心也甚欢喜。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: Yes, my heart will rejoice when your lips speak what is right.
verses.zh: 你的嘴若说正直话，我的心肠也必快乐。

words.g: and + to jump for joy, i.e. exult

verses.en: Don’t let your heart envy sinners, but rather fear the LORD all day long.
verses.zh: 你心中不要嫉妒罪人，只要终日敬畏耶和华；

words.g: to be  zealous, i.e.  jealous or envious
used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: Indeed surely there is a future hope, and your hope will not be cut off.
verses.zh: 因为至终必有善报，你的指望也不致断绝。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: Listen, my son, and be wise, and keep your heart on the right path!
verses.zh: 我儿，你当听，当存智慧，好在正道上引导你的心。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: Don’t be among ones drinking too much wine, or those who gorge themselves on meat;
verses.zh: 好饮酒的，好吃肉的，不要与他们来往；

words.g: in + to quaff to satiety, i.e. become tipsy
in + to shake , i.e. to quake

verses.en: for the drunkard and the glutton shall become poor; and drowsiness clothes them in rags.
verses.zh: 因为好酒贪食的，必致贫穷；好睡觉的，必穿破烂衣服。

words.g: to quaff to satiety, i.e. become tipsy
and + to shake , i.e. to quake

verses.en: Listen to your father who gave you life, and don’t despise your mother when she is old.
verses.zh: 你要听从生你的父亲；你母亲老了，也不可藐视她。

words.g: to + father, in a literal and immediate + +you/your

verses.en: Buy the truth, and don’t sell it. Get wisdom, discipline, and understanding.
verses.zh: 你当买真理；就是智慧、训诲，和聪明也都不可卖。

verses.en: The father of the righteous has great joy. Whoever fathers a wise child delights in him.
verses.zh: 义人的父亲必大得快乐；人生智慧的儿子，必因他欢喜。

words.g: to spin round , i.e. usually rejoice
father, in a literal and immediate

verses.en: Let your father and your mother be glad! Let her who bore you rejoice!
verses.zh: 你要使父母欢喜，使生你的快乐。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate + +you/your
and + to spin round , i.e. usually rejoice

verses.en: My son, give me your heart; and let your eyes keep in my ways.
verses.zh: 我儿，要将你的心归我；你的眼目也要喜悦我的道路。

words.g: to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one

verses.en: For a prostitute is a deep pit; and a wayward wife is a narrow well.
verses.zh: 妓女是深坑；外女是窄阱。

words.g: strange, in a variety of degrees and applications

verses.en: Yes, she lies in wait like a robber, and increases the unfaithful among men.
verses.zh: 她埋伏好像强盗；她使人中多有奸诈的。

verses.en: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?
verses.zh: 谁有祸患？谁有忧愁？谁有争斗？谁有哀叹（或译：怨言）？谁无故受伤？谁眼目红赤？

verses.en: Those who stay long at the wine; those who go to seek out mixed wine.
verses.zh: 就是那流连饮酒、常去寻找调和酒的人。

verses.en: Don’t look at the wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup, when it goes down smoothly.
verses.zh: 酒发红，在杯中闪烁，你不可观看，虽然下咽舒畅，终久是咬你如蛇，刺你如毒蛇。

words.g: in + evenness, i.e.  prosperity or concord

verses.en: In the end, it bites like a snake, and poisons like a viper.
verses.zh: a

verses.en: Your eyes will see strange things, and your mind will imagine confusing things.
verses.zh: 你眼必看见异怪的事（或译：淫妇）；你心必发出乖谬的话。

verses.en: Yes, you will be as he who lies down in the middle of the sea, or as he who lies on top of the rigging:
verses.zh: 你必像躺在海中，或像卧在桅杆上。

verses.en: “They hit me, and I was not hurt! They beat me, and I don’t feel it! When will I wake up? I can do it again. I will look for more.”
verses.zh: 你必说：人打我，我却未受伤；人鞭打我，我竟不觉得。我几时清醒，我仍去寻酒。

verses.en: Don’t be envious of evil men, neither desire to be with them;
verses.zh: 你不要嫉妒恶人，也不要起意与他们相处；

words.g: to be  zealous, i.e.  jealous or envious

verses.en: for their hearts plot violence and their lips talk about mischief.
verses.zh: 因为，他们的心图谋强暴，他们的口谈论奸恶。

verses.en: Through wisdom a house is built; by understanding it is established;
verses.zh: 房屋因智慧建造，又因聪明立稳；

verses.en: by knowledge the rooms are filled with all rare and beautiful treasure.
verses.zh: 其中因知识充满各样美好宝贵的财物。

verses.en: A wise man has great power. A knowledgeable man increases strength,
verses.zh: 智慧人大有能力；有知识的人力上加力。

words.g: to be alert, physically  or mentally

verses.en: for by wise guidance you wage your war, and victory is in many advisors.
verses.zh: 你去打仗，要凭智谋；谋士众多，人便得胜。

words.g: in + steerage , i.e.  guidance or  a plan

verses.en: Wisdom is too high for a fool. He doesn’t open his mouth in the gate.
verses.zh: 智慧极高，非愚昧人所能及，所以在城门内不敢开口。

words.g: to be high actively, to rise or raise
the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +him/his/it

verses.en: One who plots to do evil will be called a schemer.
verses.zh: 设计作恶的，必称为奸人。

verses.en: The schemes of folly are sin. The mocker is detested by men.
verses.zh: 愚妄人的思念乃是罪恶；亵慢者为人所憎恶。

words.g: a plan, especially a bad one
and + something disgusting , i.e.  an abhorrence

verses.en: If you falter in the time of trouble, your strength is small.
verses.zh: 你在患难之日若胆怯，你的力量就微小。

verses.en: Rescue those who are being led away to death! Indeed, hold back those who are staggering to the slaughter!
verses.zh: 人被拉到死地，你要解救；人将被杀，你须拦阻。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: If you say, “Behold, we didn’t know this,” doesn’t he who weighs the hearts consider it? He who keeps your soul, doesn’t he know it? Shall he not give to every man according to his work?
verses.zh: 你若说：这事我未曾知道，那衡量人心的岂不明白吗？保守你命的岂不知道吗？他岂不按各人所行的报应各人吗？

words.g: and + to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one

verses.en: My son, eat honey, for it is good, the droppings of the honeycomb, which are sweet to your taste;
verses.zh: 我儿，你要吃蜜，因为是好的；吃蜂房下滴的蜜便觉甘甜。

words.g: and + a dripping i.e. of honey
the palate or inside of the mouth + +you/your

verses.en: so you shall know wisdom to be to your soul. If you have found it, then there will be a reward: Your hope will not be cut off.
verses.zh: 你心得了智慧，也必觉得如此。你若找着，至终必有善报；你的指望也不致断绝。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: Don’t lay in wait, wicked man, against the habitation of the righteous. Don’t destroy his resting place;
verses.zh: 你这恶人，不要埋伏攻击义人的家；不要毁坏他安居之所。

words.g: a couch or place of repose + +him/his/it

verses.en: for a righteous man falls seven times and rises up again, but the wicked are overthrown by calamity.
verses.zh: 因为，义人虽七次跌倒，仍必兴起；恶人却被祸患倾倒。

verses.en: Don’t rejoice when your enemy falls. Don’t let your heart be glad when he is overthrown,
verses.zh: 你仇敌跌倒，你不要欢喜；他倾倒，你心不要快乐；

words.g: and + in + to totter or waver + +him/his/it
to spin round , i.e. usually rejoice

verses.en: lest the LORD see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.
verses.zh: 恐怕耶和华看见就不喜悦，将怒气从仇敌身上转过来。

verses.en: Don’t fret yourself because of evildoers, neither be envious of the wicked;
verses.zh: 不要为作恶的心怀不平，也不要嫉妒恶人；

words.g: to be  zealous, i.e.  jealous or envious

verses.en: for there will be no reward to the evil man. The lamp of the wicked will be snuffed out.
verses.zh: 因为，恶人终不得善报；恶人的灯也必熄灭。

verses.en: My son, fear the LORD and the king. Don’t join those who are rebellious,
verses.zh: 我儿，你要敬畏耶和华与君王，不要与反覆无常的人结交，

verses.en: for their calamity will rise suddenly. Who knows what destruction may come from them both?
verses.zh: 因为他们的灾难必忽然而起。耶和华与君王所施行的毁灭，谁能知道呢？

verses.en: These also are sayings of the wise: To show partiality in judgment is not good.
verses.zh: 以下也是智慧人的箴言：审判时看人情面是不好的。

words.g: to scrutinize, i.e. look intently at

verses.en: He who says to the wicked, “You are righteous,” peoples will curse him, and nations will abhor him—
verses.zh: 对恶人说「你是义人」的，这人万民必咒诅，列邦必憎恶。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you
to foam at the mouth, i.e. to be enraged + +him/his/it

verses.en: but it will go well with those who convict the guilty, and a rich blessing will come on them.
verses.zh: 责备恶人的，必得喜悦；美好的福也必临到他。

verses.en: An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips.
verses.zh: 应对正直的，犹如与人亲嘴。

verses.en: Prepare your work outside, and get your fields ready. Afterwards, build your house.
verses.zh: 你要在外头预备工料，在田间办理整齐，然后建造房屋。

words.g: in + separate by awall, i.e. outside

verses.en: Don’t be a witness against your neighbor without cause. Don’t deceive with your lips.
verses.zh: 不可无故作见证陷害邻舍，也不可用嘴欺骗人。

words.g: and + (question) + to open, i.e. be  roomy

verses.en: Don’t say, “I will do to him as he has done to me; I will repay the man according to his work.”
verses.zh: 不可说：人怎样待我，我也怎样待他；我必照他所行的报复他。

verses.en: I went by the field of the sluggard, by the vineyard of the man void of understanding.
verses.zh: 我经过懒惰人的田地、无知人的葡萄园，

verses.en: Behold, it was all grown over with thorns. Its surface was covered with nettles, and its stone wall was broken down.
verses.zh: 荆棘长满了地皮，刺草遮盖了田面，石墙也坍塌了。

words.g: pointed, i.e. a bramble or other thorny weed
to pull down or in pieces, break

verses.en: Then I saw, and considered well. I saw, and received instruction:
verses.zh: 我看见就留心思想；我看着就领了训诲。

verses.en: a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep,
verses.zh: 再睡片时，打盹片时，抱着手躺卧片时，

verses.en: so your poverty will come as a robber and your want as an armed man.
verses.zh: 你的贫穷就必如强盗速来，你的缺乏彷佛拿兵器的人来到。

verses.en: These also are proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.
verses.zh: 以下也是所罗门的箴言，是犹大王希西家的人所誊录的。

words.g: a pithy maxim, usually of metaphorical nature
to remove  figuratively, to grow old
Jehudah , the name of five Israelites

verses.en: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing, but the glory of kings is to search out a matter.
verses.zh: 将事隐秘乃神的荣耀；将事察清乃君王的荣耀。

words.g: weight, but only figuratively in a good sense
and + weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: As the heavens for height, and the earth for depth, so the hearts of kings are unsearchable.
verses.zh: 天之高，地之厚，君王之心也测不透。

verses.en: Take away the dross from the silver, and material comes out for the refiner.
verses.zh: 除去银子的渣滓就有银子出来，银匠能以做器皿。

verses.en: Take away the wicked from the king’s presence, and his throne will be established in righteousness.
verses.zh: 除去王面前的恶人，国位就靠公义坚立。

verses.en: Don’t exalt yourself in the presence of the king, or claim a place among great men;
verses.zh: 不要在王面前妄自尊大；不要在大人的位上站立。

verses.en: for it is better that it be said to you, “Come up here,” than that you should be put lower in the presence of the prince, whom your eyes have seen.
verses.zh: 宁可有人说：请你上来，强如在你觐见的王子面前叫你退下。

verses.en: Don’t be hasty in bringing charges to court. What will you do in the end when your neighbor shames you?
verses.zh: 不要冒失出去与人争竞，免得至终被他羞辱，你就不知道怎样行了。

words.g: in + the last or end, hence + +her/its

verses.en: Debate your case with your neighbor, and don’t betray the confidence of another,
verses.zh: 你与邻舍争讼，要与他一人辩论，不可泄漏人的密事，

verses.en: lest one who hears it put you to shame, and your bad reputation never depart.
verses.zh: 恐怕听见的人骂你，你的臭名就难以脱离。

words.g: perhaps to bow , i.e. to be kind + +you/your

verses.en: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.
verses.zh: 一句话说得合宜，就如金苹果在银网子里。

words.g: an apple , i.e. the fruit or the tree

verses.en: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear.
verses.zh: 智慧人的劝戒，在顺从的人耳中，好像金耳环和精金的妆饰。

verses.en: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to those who send him; for he refreshes the soul of his masters.
verses.zh: 忠信的使者叫差他的人心里舒畅，就如在收割时有冰雪的凉气。

verses.en: As clouds and wind without rain, so is he who boasts of gifts deceptively.
verses.zh: 空夸赠送礼物的，好像无雨的风云。

words.g: an exalted one, i.e. a king or sheik

verses.en: By patience a ruler is persuaded. A soft tongue breaks the bone.
verses.zh: 恒常忍耐可以劝动君王；柔和的舌头能折断骨头。

verses.en: Have you found honey? Eat as much as is sufficient for you, lest you eat too much, and vomit it.
verses.zh: 你得了蜜吗？只可吃够而已，恐怕你过饱就呕吐出来。

words.g: enough , used chiefly with preposition in phrases + +you/your

verses.en: Let your foot be seldom in your neighbor’s house, lest he be weary of you, and hate you.
verses.zh: 你的脚要少进邻舍的家，恐怕他厌烦你，恨恶你。

verses.en: A man who gives false testimony against his neighbor is like a club, a sword, or a sharp arrow.
verses.zh: 作假见证陷害邻舍的，就是大槌，是利刀，是快箭。

verses.en: Confidence in someone unfaithful in time of trouble is like a bad tooth or a lame foot.
verses.zh: 患难时倚靠不忠诚的人，好像破坏的牙，错骨缝的脚。

verses.en: As one who takes away a garment in cold weather, or vinegar on soda, so is one who sings songs to a heavy heart.
verses.zh: 对伤心的人唱歌，就如冷天脱衣服，又如硷上倒醋。

words.g: to advance, i.e. pass on or continue

verses.en: If your enemy is hungry, give him food to eat. If he is thirsty, give him water to drink;
verses.zh: 你的仇敌若饿了，就给他饭吃；若渴了，就给他水喝；

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
and + used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
to quaff, i.e.  to irrigate or furnish apotion to + +him/his/it

verses.en: for you will heap coals of fire on his head, and the LORD will reward you.
verses.zh: 因为，你这样行就是把炭火堆在他的头上；耶和华也必赏赐你。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: The north wind produces rain; so a backbiting tongue brings an angry face.
verses.zh: 北风生雨，谗谤人的舌头也生怒容。

words.g: to twist or whirl , i.e.  to dance
to foam at the mouth, i.e. to be enraged

verses.en: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.
verses.zh: 宁可住在房顶的角上，不在宽阔的房屋与争吵的妇人同住。

verses.en: Like cold water to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.
verses.zh: 有好消息从远方来，就如拿凉水给口渴的人喝。

words.g: and + something heard, i.e. an announcement

verses.en: Like a muddied spring and a polluted well, so is a righteous man who gives way before the wicked.
verses.zh: 义人在恶人面前退缩，好像逿浑之泉，弄浊之井。

words.g: and + something dug, i.e. a  source

verses.en: It is not good to eat much honey, nor is it honorable to seek one’s own honor.
verses.zh: 吃蜜过多是不好的；考究自己的荣耀也是可厌的。

words.g: weight, but only figuratively in a good sense + +them/their
weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: Like a city that is broken down and without walls is a man whose spirit is without restraint.
verses.zh: 人不制伏自己的心，好像毁坏的城邑没有墙垣。

verses.en: Like snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honor is not fitting for a fool.
verses.zh: 夏天落雪，收割时下雨，都不相宜；愚昧人得尊荣也是如此。

words.g: in + harvest , whether the product  or the  season
to + fat, i.e.  stupid or silly
weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: Like a fluttering sparrow, like a darting swallow, so the undeserved curse doesn’t come to rest.
verses.zh: 麻雀往来，燕子翻飞；这样，无故的咒诅也必不临到。

words.g: like + the swift, a kind of swallow

verses.en: A whip is for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, and a rod for the back of fools!
verses.zh: 鞭子是为打马，辔头是为勒驴；刑杖是为打愚昧人的背。

verses.en: Don’t answer a fool according to his folly, lest you also be like him.
verses.zh: 不要照愚昧人的愚妄话回答他，恐怕你与他一样。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own eyes.
verses.zh: 要照愚昧人的愚妄话回答他，免得他自以为有智慧。

verses.en: One who sends a message by the hand of a fool is cutting off feet and drinking violence.
verses.zh: 藉愚昧人手寄信的，是砍断自己的脚，自受（原文是：喝）损害。

verses.en: Like the legs of the lame that hang loose, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
verses.zh: 瘸子的脚空存无用；箴言在愚昧人的口中也是如此。

words.g: and + a pithy maxim, usually of metaphorical nature
in + the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.en: As one who binds a stone in a sling, so is he who gives honor to a fool.
verses.zh: 将尊荣给愚昧人的，好像人把石子包在机弦里。

words.g: like + to cramp, literally or figuratively
to + fat, i.e.  stupid or silly
weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: Like a thorn bush that goes into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
verses.zh: 箴言在愚昧人的口中，好像荆棘刺入醉汉的手。

words.g: intoxicated, as astate or a habit
and + a pithy maxim, usually of metaphorical nature
in + the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.en: As an archer who wounds all, so is he who hires a fool or he who hires those who pass by.
verses.zh: 雇愚昧人的，与雇过路人的，就像射伤众人的弓箭手。

words.g: to twist or whirl , i.e.  to dance

verses.en: As a dog that returns to his vomit, so is a fool who repeats his folly.
verses.zh: 愚昧人行愚妄事，行了又行，就如狗转过来吃它所吐的。

verses.en: Do you see a man wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
verses.zh: 你见自以为有智慧的人吗？愚昧人比他更有指望。

words.g: to + fat, i.e.  stupid or silly

verses.en: The sluggard says, “There is a lion in the road! A fierce lion roams the streets!”
verses.zh: 懒惰人说：道上有猛狮，街上有壮狮。

words.g: the + a width, i.e.  avenue or area

verses.en: As the door turns on its hinges, so does the sluggard on his bed.
verses.zh: 门在枢纽转动，懒惰人在床上也是如此。

words.g: the + something swinging, i.e. the valve of adoor

verses.en: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish. He is too lazy to bring it back to his mouth.
verses.zh: 懒惰人放手在盘子里，就是向口撤回也以为劳乏。

words.g: in + something advanced or deep, i.e. a bowl
the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +him/his/it

verses.en: The sluggard is wiser in his own eyes than seven men who answer with discretion.
verses.zh: 懒惰人看自己比七个善于应对的人更有智慧。

verses.en: Like one who grabs a dog’s ears is one who passes by and meddles in a quarrel not his own.
verses.zh: 过路被事激动，管理不干己的争竞，好像人揪住狗耳。

verses.en: Like a madman who shoots torches, arrows, and death,
verses.zh: 人欺凌邻舍，却说：我岂不是戏耍吗？他就像疯狂的人抛掷火把、利箭，与杀人的兵器（原文是死亡）。

words.g: what leaps forth, i.e. flash of fire

verses.en: is the man who deceives his neighbor and says, “Am I not joking?”
verses.zh: a

verses.en: For lack of wood a fire goes out. Without gossip, a quarrel dies down.
verses.zh: 火缺了柴就必熄灭；无人传舌，争竞便止息。

verses.en: As coals are to hot embers, and wood to fire, so is a contentious man to kindling strife.
verses.zh: 好争竞的人煽惑争端，就如余火加炭，火上加柴一样。

words.g: a coal, whether charred or live
to + to glow, i.e. literally  or figuratively

verses.en: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels, they go down into the innermost parts.
verses.zh: 传舌人的言语，如同美食，深入人的心腹。

words.g: like + to burn in, i.e.  to rankle

verses.en: Like silver dross on an earthen vessel are the lips of a fervent one with an evil heart.
verses.zh: 火热的嘴，奸恶的心，好像银渣包的瓦器。

verses.en: A malicious man disguises himself with his lips, but he harbors evil in his heart.
verses.zh: 怨恨人的，用嘴粉饰，心里却藏着诡诈；

words.g: to scrutinize, i.e. look intently at
and + in + the nearest part, i.e. the center + +him/his/it

verses.en: When his speech is charming, don’t believe him, for there are seven abominations in his heart.
verses.zh: 他用甜言蜜语，你不可信他，因为他心中有七样可憎恶的。

verses.en: His malice may be concealed by deception, but his wickedness will be exposed in the assembly.
verses.zh: 他虽用诡诈遮掩自己的怨恨，他的邪恶必在会中显露。

verses.en: Whoever digs a pit shall fall into it. Whoever rolls a stone, it will come back on him.
verses.zh: 挖陷坑的，自己必掉在其中；滚石头的，石头必反滚在他身上。

verses.en: A lying tongue hates those it hurts; and a flattering mouth works ruin.
verses.zh: 虚谎的舌恨他所压伤的人；谄媚的口败坏人的事。

words.g: and + the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.en: Don’t boast about tomorrow; for you don’t know what a day may bring.
verses.zh: 不要为明日自夸，因为一日要生何事，你尚且不能知道。

verses.en: Let another man praise you, and not your own mouth; a stranger, and not your own lips.
verses.zh: 要别人夸奖你，不可用口自夸；等外人称赞你，不可用嘴自称。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +you/your
strange, in a variety of degrees and applications

verses.en: A stone is heavy, and sand is a burden; but a fool’s provocation is heavier than both.
verses.zh: 石头重，沙土沉，愚妄人的恼怒比这两样更重。

verses.en: Wrath is cruel, and anger is overwhelming; but who is able to stand before jealousy?
verses.zh: 忿怒为残忍，怒气为狂澜，惟有嫉妒，谁能敌得住呢？

verses.en: Better is open rebuke than hidden love.
verses.zh: 当面的责备强如背地的爱情。

verses.en: The wounds of a friend are faithful, although the kisses of an enemy are profuse.
verses.zh: 朋友加的伤痕出于忠诚；仇敌连连亲嘴却是多余。

verses.en: A full soul loathes a honeycomb; but to a hungry soul, every bitter thing is sweet.
verses.zh: 人吃饱了，厌恶蜂房的蜜；人饥饿了，一切苦物都觉甘甜。

verses.en: As a bird that wanders from her nest, so is a man who wanders from his home.
verses.zh: 人离本处飘流，好像雀鸟离窝游飞。

words.g: a nest , sometimes including the nestlings + +her/its

verses.en: Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart; so does earnest counsel from a man’s friend.
verses.zh: 膏油与香料使人心喜悦；朋友诚实的劝教也是如此甘美。

verses.en: Don’t forsake your friend and your father’s friend. Don’t go to your brother’s house in the day of your disaster. A neighbor who is near is better than a distant brother.
verses.zh: 你的朋友和父亲的朋友，你都不可离弃。你遭难的日子，不要上弟兄的家去；相近的邻舍强如远方的弟兄。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate + +you/your

verses.en: Be wise, my son, and bring joy to my heart, then I can answer my tormentor.
verses.zh: 我儿，你要作智慧人，好叫我的心欢喜，使我可以回答那讥诮我的人。

words.g: to pull off, i.e.  to expose + +me/my

verses.en: A prudent man sees danger and takes refuge; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.
verses.zh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

verses.en: Take his garment when he puts up collateral for a stranger. Hold it for a wayward woman!
verses.zh: 谁为生人作保，就拿谁的衣服；谁为外女作保，谁就承当。

words.g: strange, in a variety of degrees and applications
to wind tightly , i.e. to bind + +him/his/it

verses.en: He who blesses his neighbor with a loud voice early in the morning, it will be taken as a curse by him.
verses.zh: 清晨起来，大声给朋友祝福的，就算是咒诅他。

words.g: to load up , i.e. to start early in the morning

verses.en: A continual dropping on a rainy day and a contentious wife are alike:
verses.zh: 大雨之日连连滴漏，和争吵的妇人一样；

verses.en: restraining her is like restraining the wind, or like grasping oil in his right hand.
verses.zh: 想拦阻她的，便是拦阻风，也是右手抓油。

verses.en: Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.
verses.zh: 铁磨铁，磨出刃来；朋友相感（原文是磨朋友的脸）也是如此。

verses.en: Whoever tends the fig tree shall eat its fruit. He who looks after his master shall be honored.
verses.zh: 看守无花果树的，必吃树上的果子；敬奉主人的，必得尊荣。

words.g: to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one

verses.en: Like water reflects a face, so a man’s heart reflects the man.
verses.zh: 水中照脸，彼此相符；人与人，心也相对。

verses.en: Sheol and Abaddon are never satisfied; and a man’s eyes are never satisfied.
verses.zh: 阴间和灭亡永不满足；人的眼目也是如此。

verses.en: The crucible is for silver, and the furnace for gold; but man is refined by his praise.
verses.zh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

words.g: to + the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.en: Though you grind a fool in a mortar with a pestle along with grain, yet his foolishness will not be removed from him.
verses.zh: 你虽用杵将愚妄人与打碎的麦子一同捣在臼中，他的愚妄还是离不了他。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: Know well the state of your flocks, and pay attention to your herds,
verses.zh: 你要详细知道你羊群的景况，留心料理你的牛群；

verses.en: for riches are not forever, nor does the crown endure to all generations.
verses.zh: 因为资财不能永有，冠冕岂能存到万代？

words.g: and + used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: The hay is removed, and the new growth appears, the grasses of the hills are gathered in.
verses.zh: 干草割去，嫩草发现，山上的菜蔬也被收敛。

words.g: and + to gather for any purpose

verses.en: The lambs are for your clothing, and the goats are the price of a field.
verses.zh: 羊羔之毛是为你作衣服；山羊是为作田地的价值，

verses.en: There will be plenty of goats’ milk for your food, for your family’s food, and for the nourishment of your servant girls.
verses.zh: 并有母山羊奶够你吃，也够你的家眷吃，且够养你的婢女。

words.g: and + enough , used chiefly with preposition in phrases
a she-goat , but masculine in plural

verses.en: The wicked flee when no one pursues; but the righteous are as bold as a lion.
verses.zh: 恶人虽无人追赶也逃跑；义人却胆壮像狮子。

verses.en: In rebellion, a land has many rulers, but order is maintained by a man of understanding and knowledge.
verses.zh: 邦国因有罪过，君王就多更换；因有聪明知识的人，国必长存。

verses.en: A needy man who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain which leaves no crops.
verses.zh: 穷人欺压贫民，好像暴雨冲没粮食。

words.g: and + to press upon, i.e. oppress

verses.en: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked; but those who keep the law contend with them.
verses.zh: 违弃律法的，夸奖恶人；遵守律法的，却与恶人相争。

verses.en: Evil men don’t understand justice; but those who seek the LORD understand it fully.
verses.zh: 坏人不明白公义；惟有寻求耶和华的，无不明白。

verses.en: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his ways, and he is rich.
verses.zh: 行为纯正的穷乏人胜过行事乖僻的富足人。

verses.en: Whoever keeps the law is a wise son; but he who is a companion of gluttons shames his father.
verses.zh: 谨守律法的，是智慧之子；与贪食人作伴的，却羞辱其父。

words.g: to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one
father, in a literal and immediate + +him/his/it

verses.en: He who increases his wealth by excessive interest gathers it for one who has pity on the poor.
verses.zh: 人以厚利加增财物，是给那怜悯穷人者积蓄的。

words.g: and + multiplication, i.e. percentage or bonus in addition to principal

verses.en: He who turns away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer is an abomination.
verses.zh: 转耳不听律法的，他的祈祷也为可憎。

verses.en: Whoever causes the upright to go astray in an evil way, he will fall into his own trap; but the blameless will inherit good.
verses.zh: 诱惑正直人行恶道的，必掉在自己的坑里；惟有完全人必承受福分。

words.g: to inherit  mode of descent), or  to occupy

verses.en: The rich man is wise in his own eyes; but the poor who has understanding sees through him.
verses.zh: 富足人自以为有智慧，但聪明的贫穷人能将他查透。

words.g: and + dangling, i.e.  weak or thin

verses.en: When the righteous triumph, there is great glory; but when the wicked rise, men hide themselves.
verses.zh: 义人得志，有大荣耀；恶人兴起，人就躲藏。

words.g: in + to jump for joy, i.e. exult

verses.en: He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.
verses.zh: 遮掩自己罪过的，必不亨通；承认离弃罪过的，必蒙怜恤。

words.g: to push forward, in various senses

verses.en: Blessed is the man who always fears; but one who hardens his heart falls into trouble.
verses.zh: 常存敬畏的，便为有福；心存刚硬的，必陷在祸患里。

words.g: and + to be dense, i.e. tough or severe

verses.en: As a roaring lion or a charging bear, so is a wicked ruler over helpless people.
verses.zh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

verses.en: A tyrannical ruler lacks judgment. One who hates ill-gotten gain will have long days.
verses.zh: 无知的君多行暴虐；以贪财为可恨的，必年长日久。

verses.en: A man who is tormented by blood guilt will be a fugitive until death. No one will support him.
verses.zh: 背负流人血之罪的，必往坑里奔跑，谁也不可拦阻他。

verses.en: Whoever walks blamelessly is kept safe; but one with perverse ways will fall suddenly.
verses.zh: 行动正直的，必蒙拯救；行事弯曲的，立时跌倒。

words.g: to be open, wide or free

verses.en: One who works his land will have an abundance of food; but one who chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty.
verses.zh: 耕种自己田地的，必得饱食；追随虚浮的，足受穷乏。

verses.en: A faithful man is rich with blessings; but one who is eager to be rich will not go unpunished.
verses.zh: 诚实人必多得福；想要急速发财的，不免受罚。

verses.en: To show partiality is not good, yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread.
verses.zh: 看人的情面乃为不好；人因一块饼枉法也为不好。

words.g: to scrutinize, i.e. look intently at

verses.en: A stingy man hurries after riches, and doesn’t know that poverty waits for him.
verses.zh: 人有恶眼想要急速发财，却不知穷乏必临到他身。

words.g: to tremble inwardly , i.e.  be   alarmed or agitated

verses.en: One who rebukes a man will afterward find more favor than one who flatters with the tongue.
verses.zh: 责备人的，后来蒙人喜悦，多于那用舌头谄媚人的。

verses.en: Whoever robs his father or his mother and says, “It’s not wrong,” is a partner with a destroyer.
verses.zh: 偷窃父母的，说：这不是罪，此人就是与强盗同类。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate + +him/his/it

verses.en: One who is greedy stirs up strife; but one who trusts in the LORD will prosper.
verses.zh: 心中贪婪的，挑起争端；倚靠耶和华的，必得丰裕。

verses.en: One who trusts in himself is a fool; but one who walks in wisdom is kept safe.
verses.zh: 心中自是的，便是愚昧人；凭智慧行事的，必蒙拯救。

words.g: to be smooth, i.e.  to escape

verses.en: One who gives to the poor has no lack; but one who closes his eyes will have many curses.
verses.zh: 周济贫穷的，不致缺乏；佯为不见的，必多受咒诅。

words.g: and + to veil from sight, i.e. conceal

verses.en: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves; but when they perish, the righteous thrive.
verses.zh: 恶人兴起，人就躲藏；恶人败亡，义人增多。

verses.en: He who is often rebuked and stiffens his neck will be destroyed suddenly, with no remedy.
verses.zh: 人屡次受责罚，仍然硬着颈项；他必顷刻败坏，无法可治。

words.g: to be dense, i.e. tough or severe
the nape or back of the neck

verses.en: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; but when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verses.zh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。

verses.en: Whoever loves wisdom brings joy to his father; but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.
verses.zh: 爱慕智慧的，使父亲喜乐；与妓女结交的，却浪费钱财。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate + +him/his/it

verses.en: The king by justice makes the land stable, but he who takes bribes tears it down.
verses.zh: 王藉公平，使国坚定；索要贿赂，使国倾败。

words.g: a present , especially in sacrifice or as tribute
to pull down or in pieces, break + +her/its

verses.en: A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet.
verses.zh: 谄媚邻舍的，就是设网罗绊他的脚。

verses.en: An evil man is snared by his sin, but the righteous can sing and be glad.
verses.zh: 恶人犯罪，自陷网罗；惟独义人欢呼喜乐。

verses.en: The righteous care about justice for the poor. The wicked aren’t concerned about knowledge.
verses.zh: 义人知道查明穷人的案；恶人没有聪明，就不得而知。

verses.en: Mockers stir up a city, but wise men turn away anger.
verses.zh: 亵慢人煽惑通城；智慧人止息众怒。

words.g: to puff, i.e. blow with the breath or air

verses.en: If a wise man goes to court with a foolish man, the fool rages or scoffs, and there is no peace.
verses.zh: 智慧人与愚妄人相争，或怒或笑，总不能使他止息。

verses.en: The bloodthirsty hate a man of integrity; and they seek the life of the upright.
verses.zh: 好流人血的，恨恶完全人，索取正直人的性命。

verses.en: A fool vents all of his anger, but a wise man brings himself under control.
verses.zh: 愚妄人怒气全发；智慧人忍气含怒。

words.g: to address in aloud tone, i.e.  loud + +her/its

verses.en: If a ruler listens to lies, all of his officials are wicked.
verses.zh: 君王若听谎言，他一切臣仆都是奸恶。

words.g: to prick up the ears, i.e. hearken
to attend as a menial or worshipper + +him/his/it

verses.en: The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: The LORD gives sight to the eyes of both.
verses.zh: 贫穷人、强暴人在世相遇；他们的眼目都蒙耶和华光照。

words.g: to come in contact with, whether by accident or violence

verses.en: The king who fairly judges the poor, his throne shall be established forever.
verses.zh: 君王凭诚实判断穷人；他的国位必永远坚立。

verses.en: The rod of correction gives wisdom, but a child left to himself causes shame to his mother.
verses.zh: 杖打和责备能加增智慧；放纵的儿子使母亲羞愧。

words.g: and + a boy , from the age of infancy to adolescence
to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed

verses.en: When the wicked increase, sin increases; but the righteous will see their downfall.
verses.zh: 恶人加多，过犯也加多，义人必看见他们跌倒。

verses.en: Correct your son, and he will give you peace; yes, he will bring delight to your soul.
verses.zh: 管教你的儿子，他就使你得安息，也必使你心里喜乐。

words.g: and + to rest, i.e. settle down + +you/your

verses.en: Where there is no revelation, the people cast off restraint; but one who keeps the law is blessed.
verses.zh: 没有异象（或译：默示），民就放肆；惟遵守律法的，便为有福。

verses.en: A servant can’t be corrected by words. Though he understands, yet he will not respond.
verses.zh: 只用言语，仆人不肯受管教；他虽然明白，也不留意。

verses.en: Do you see a man who is hasty in his words? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
verses.zh: 你见言语急躁的人吗？愚昧人比他更有指望。

words.g: to + fat, i.e.  stupid or silly

verses.en: He who pampers his servant from youth will have him become a son in the end.
verses.zh: 人将仆人从小娇养，这仆人终久必成了他的儿子。

words.g: and + the last or end, hence + +him/his/it

verses.en: An angry man stirs up strife, and a wrathful man abounds in sin.
verses.zh: 好气的人挑启争端；暴怒的人多多犯罪。

verses.en: A man’s pride brings him low, but one of lowly spirit gains honor.
verses.zh: 人的高傲必使他卑下；心里谦逊的，必得尊荣。

words.g: weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: Whoever is an accomplice of a thief is an enemy of his own soul. He takes an oath, but dares not testify.
verses.zh: 人与盗贼分赃，是恨恶自己的性命；他听见叫人发誓的声音，却不言语。

verses.en: The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in the LORD is kept safe.
verses.zh: 惧怕人的，陷入网罗；惟有倚靠耶和华的，必得安稳。

verses.en: Many seek the ruler’s favor, but a man’s justice comes from the LORD.
verses.zh: 求王恩的人多；定人事乃在耶和华。

verses.en: A dishonest man detests the righteous, and the upright in their ways detest the wicked.
verses.zh: 为非作歹的，被义人憎嫌；行事正直的，被恶人憎恶。

words.g: and + something disgusting , i.e.  an abhorrence

verses.en: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, the revelation: the man says to Ithiel, to Ithiel and Ucal:
verses.zh: 雅基的儿子亚古珥的言语就是真言。这人对以铁和乌甲说：

words.g: Agur, a fanciful name for Solomon
the + a valiant man or warrior
to + Ithiel, the name of an Israelite
to + Ithiel, the name of an Israelite

verses.en: “Surely I am the most ignorant man, and don’t have a man’s understanding.
verses.zh: 我比众人更蠢笨，也没有人的聪明。

verses.en: I have not learned wisdom, neither do I have the knowledge of the Holy One.
verses.zh: 我没有学好智慧，也不认识至圣者。

verses.en: Who has ascended up into heaven, and descended? Who has gathered the wind in his fists? Who has bound the waters in his garment? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is his name, and what is his son’s name, if you know?
verses.zh: 谁升天又降下来？谁聚风在掌握中？谁包水在衣服里？谁立定地的四极？他名叫甚么？他儿子名叫甚么？你知道吗？

words.g: in + a dress, especially a mantle

verses.en: “Every word of God is flawless. He is a shield to those who take refuge in him.
verses.zh: 神的言语句句都是炼净的；投靠他的，他便作他们的盾牌。

verses.en: Don’t you add to his words, lest he reprove you, and you be found a liar.
verses.zh: 他的言语，你不可加添，恐怕他责备你，你就显为说谎言的。

words.g: and + to lie , literally or figuratively

verses.en: “Two things I have asked of you. Don’t deny me before I die.
verses.zh: 我求你两件事，在我未死之先，不要不赐给我：

words.g: to debar  from benefit or injury

verses.en: Remove far from me falsehood and lies. Give me neither poverty nor riches. Feed me with the food that is needful for me,
verses.zh: 求你使虚假和谎言远离我；使我也不贫穷也不富足；赐给我需用的饮食，

words.g: to widen , i.e.  recede or  remove

verses.en: lest I be full, deny you, and say, ‘Who is the LORD?’ or lest I be poor, and steal, and so dishonor the name of my God.
verses.zh: 恐怕我饱足不认你，说：耶和华是谁呢？又恐怕我贫穷就偷窃，以致亵渎我神的名。

words.g: and + to be untrue, in word  or deed

verses.en: “Don’t slander a servant to his master, lest he curse you, and you be held guilty.
verses.zh: 你不要向主人谗谤仆人，恐怕他咒诅你，你便算为有罪。

words.g: to wag the tongue, i.e. to calumniate

verses.en: There is a generation that curses their father, and doesn’t bless their mother.
verses.zh: 有一宗人（宗：原文是代；下同），咒诅父亲，不给母亲祝福。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate + +him/his/it

verses.en: There is a generation that is pure in their own eyes, yet are not washed from their filthiness.
verses.zh: 有一宗人，自以为清洁，却没有洗去自己的污秽。

verses.en: There is a generation, oh how lofty are their eyes! Their eyelids are lifted up.
verses.zh: 有一宗人，眼目何其高傲，眼皮也是高举。

words.g: to be high actively, to rise or raise

verses.en: There is a generation whose teeth are like swords, and their jaws like knives, to devour the poor from the earth, and the needy from among men.
verses.zh: 有一宗人，牙如剑，齿如刀，要吞灭地上的困苦人和世间的穷乏人。

words.g: and + something to eat with,i.e. a knife

verses.en: “The leech has two daughters: ‘Give, give.’ “There are three things that are never satisfied; four that don’t say, ‘Enough!’:
verses.zh: 蚂蟥有两个女儿，常说：给呀，给呀！有三样不知足的，连不说「够的」共有四样：

verses.en: Sheol, the barren womb, the earth that is not satisfied with water, and the fire that doesn’t say, ‘Enough!’
verses.zh: 就是阴间和石胎，浸水不足的地，并火。

verses.en: “The eye that mocks at his father, and scorns obedience to his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, the young eagles shall eat it.
verses.zh: 戏笑父亲、藐视而不听从母亲的，他的眼睛必为谷中的乌鸦啄出来，为鹰雏所吃。

words.g: to + father, in a literal and immediate
a stream, especially a winter torrent

verses.en: “There are three things which are too amazing for me, four which I don’t understand:
verses.zh: 我所测不透的奇妙有三样，连我所不知道的共有四样：

verses.en: The way of an eagle in the air, the way of a serpent on a rock, the way of a ship in the middle of the sea, and the way of a man with a maiden.
verses.zh: 就是鹰在空中飞的道；蛇在磐石上爬的道；船在海中行的道；男与女交合的道。

verses.en: “So is the way of an adulterous woman: She eats and wipes her mouth, and says, ‘I have done nothing wrong.’
verses.zh: 淫妇的道也是这样：她吃了，把嘴一擦就说：我没有行恶。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +her/its
to do or make , especially to practise

verses.en: “For three things the earth trembles, and under four, it can’t bear up:
verses.zh: 使地震动的有三样，连地担不起的共有四样：

verses.en: For a servant when he is king, a fool when he is filled with food,
verses.zh: 就是仆人作王；愚顽人吃饱；

verses.en: for an unloved woman when she is married, and a servant who is heir to her mistress.
verses.zh: 丑恶的女子出嫁；婢女接续主母。

verses.en: “There are four things which are little on the earth, but they are exceedingly wise:
verses.zh: 地上有四样小物，却甚聪明：

verses.en: The ants are not a strong people, yet they provide their food in the summer.
verses.zh: 蚂蚁是无力之类，却在夏天预备粮食。

words.g: in + harvest , whether the product  or the  season

verses.en: The hyraxes are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks.
verses.zh: 沙番是软弱之类，却在磐石中造房。

words.g: a species of rockrabbit , i.e. probably the hyrax
in + a craggy rock, literally or figuratively

verses.en: The locusts have no king, yet they advance in ranks.
verses.zh: 蝗虫没有君王，却分队而出。

words.g: to chop into, pierce or sever

verses.en: You can catch a lizard with your hands, yet it is in kings’ palaces.
verses.zh: 守宫用爪抓墙，却住在王宫。

verses.en: “There are three things which are stately in their march, four which are stately in going:
verses.zh: 步行威武的有三样，连行走威武的共有四样：

verses.en: The lion, which is mightiest among animals, and doesn’t turn away for any;
verses.zh: 就是狮子―乃百兽中最为猛烈、无所躲避的，

verses.en: the greyhound; the male goat; and the king against whom there is no rising up.
verses.zh: 猎狗，公山羊，和无人能敌的君王。

words.g: tightly girt, i.e. probably a racer
the waist or small of the back

verses.en: “If you have done foolishly in lifting up yourself, or if you have thought evil, put your hand over your mouth.
verses.zh: 你若行事愚顽，自高自傲，或是怀了恶念，就当用手捂口。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
and + used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
to plan, usually in a bad sense
to + the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.en: For as the churning of milk produces butter, and the wringing of the nose produces blood, so the forcing of wrath produces strife.”
verses.zh: 摇牛奶必成奶油；扭鼻子必出血。照样，激动怒气必起争端。

verses.en: The words of King Lemuel—the revelation which his mother taught him:
verses.zh: 利慕伊勒王的言语，是他母亲教训他的真言。

words.g: Lemuel or Lemoel, a symbolic name of Solomon

verses.en: “Oh, my son! Oh, son of my womb! Oh, son of my vows!
verses.zh: 我的儿啊，我腹中生的儿啊，我许愿得的儿啊！我当怎样教训你呢？

verses.en: Don’t give your strength to women, nor your ways to that which destroys kings.
verses.zh: 不要将你的精力给妇女；也不要有败坏君王的行为。

words.g: probably a force, whether of men + +you/your

verses.en: It is not for kings, Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, nor for princes to say, ‘Where is strong drink?’
verses.zh: 利慕伊勒啊，君王喝酒，君王喝酒不相宜；王子说浓酒在那里也不相宜；

words.g: Lemuel or Lemoel, a symbolic name of Solomon
and + to + probably to be heavy, i.e.  honorable
an intoxicant, i.e. intensely alcoholic liquor

verses.en: lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the justice due to anyone who is afflicted.
verses.zh: 恐怕喝了就忘记律例，颠倒一切困苦人的是非。

words.g: and + to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of

verses.en: Give strong drink to him who is ready to perish, and wine to the bitter in soul.
verses.zh: 可以把浓酒给将亡的人喝，把清酒给苦心的人喝，

words.g: an intoxicant, i.e. intensely alcoholic liquor

verses.en: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
verses.zh: 让他喝了，就忘记他的贫穷，不再记念他的苦楚。

words.g: and + to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of

verses.en: Open your mouth for the mute, in the cause of all who are left desolate.
verses.zh: 你当为哑巴（或译：不能自辩的）开口，为一切孤独的伸冤。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +you/your

verses.en: Open your mouth, judge righteously, and serve justice to the poor and needy.”
verses.zh: 你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +you/your
and + a straight course, i.e. sail direct

verses.en: Who can find a worthy woman? For her value is far above rubies.
verses.zh: 才德的妇人谁能得着呢？她的价值远胜过珍珠。

words.g: probably a force, whether of men

verses.en: The heart of her husband trusts in her. He shall have no lack of gain.
verses.zh: 她丈夫心里倚靠她，必不缺少利益；

verses.en: She does him good, and not harm, all the days of her life.
verses.zh: 她一生使丈夫有益无损。

words.g: to treat a person , i.e. benefit or requite + +him/his/it

verses.en: She seeks wool and flax, and works eagerly with her hands.
verses.zh: 她寻找羊羢和麻，甘心用手做工。

verses.en: She is like the merchant ships. She brings her bread from afar.
verses.zh: 她好像商船从远方运粮来，

words.g: from + remoteness, i.e.  a distant place

verses.en: She rises also while it is yet night, gives food to her household, and portions for her servant girls.
verses.zh: 未到黎明她就起来，把食物分给家中的人，将当做的工分派婢女。

verses.en: She considers a field, and buys it. With the fruit of her hands, she plants a vineyard.
verses.zh: 她想得田地就买来；用手所得之利栽种葡萄园。

words.g: to plan, usually in a bad sense

verses.en: She arms her waist with strength, and makes her arms strong.
verses.zh: 她以能力束腰，使膀臂有力。

words.g: the waist or small of the back + +her/its
and + to be alert, physically  or mentally

verses.en: She perceives that her merchandise is profitable. Her lamp doesn’t go out by night.
verses.zh: 她觉得所经营的有利；她的灯终夜不灭。

verses.en: She lays her hands to the distaff, and her hands hold the spindle.
verses.zh: 她手拿捻线竿，手把纺线车。

words.g: in + a director, i.e. the spindle or shank of adistaff

verses.en: She opens her arms to the poor; yes, she extends her hands to the needy.
verses.zh: 她张手周济困苦人，伸手帮补穷乏人。

words.g: to + depressed, in mind or circumstances

verses.en: She is not afraid of the snow for her household, for all her household are clothed with scarlet.
verses.zh: 她不因下雪为家里的人担心，因为全家都穿着朱红衣服。

verses.en: She makes for herself carpets of tapestry. Her clothing is fine linen and purple.
verses.zh: 她为自己制作绣花毯子；她的衣服是细麻和紫色布做的。

words.g: bleached stuff, i.e. white linen or  marble

verses.en: Her husband is respected in the gates, when he sits among the elders of the land.
verses.zh: 她丈夫在城门口与本地的长老同坐，为众人所认识。

verses.en: She makes linen garments and sells them, and delivers sashes to the merchant.
verses.zh: 她做细麻布衣裳出卖，又将腰带卖与商家。

words.g: to + a Kenaanite or inhabitant of Kenaan

verses.en: Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.
verses.zh: 能力和威仪是她的衣服；她想到日后的景况就喜笑。

words.g: and + magnificence, i.e. ornament or splendor

verses.en: She opens her mouth with wisdom. Kind instruction is on her tongue.
verses.zh: 她开口就发智慧；她舌上有仁慈的法则。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +her/its

verses.en: She looks well to the ways of her household, and doesn’t eat the bread of idleness.
verses.zh: 她观察家务，并不吃闲饭。

words.g: to lean forward, i.e. to peer into the distance

verses.en: Her children rise up and call her blessed. Her husband also praises her:
verses.zh: 她的儿女起来称她有福；她的丈夫也称赞她，

verses.en: “Many women do noble things, but you excel them all.”
verses.zh: 说：才德的女子很多，惟独你超过一切。

words.g: probably a force, whether of men
and + thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears the LORD, she shall be praised.
verses.zh: 艳丽是虚假的，美容是虚浮的；惟敬畏耶和华的妇女必得称赞。

words.g: the + graciousness, i.e. subjective  or objective

verses.en: Give her of the fruit of her hands! Let her works praise her in the gates!
verses.zh: 愿她享受操作所得的；愿她的工作在城门口荣耀她。
